economy.zh:
今日经济新闻的核心线索是地缘冲突与通胀压力的双重夹击。OECD因美伊战争下调全球增长预期，同时警告冲突影响将持续；欧元区通胀升至3.2%，强化了欧洲央行6月加息的预期。美国则再挥关税大棒，拟对60个经济体征收10%-12.5%的新关税，全球贸易格局面临新一轮冲击。资本市场出现明显分化：比特币因巨额IPO分流跌至2月新低，AI主题资金激烈争夺；欧洲科技股受STMicroelectronics带动走强，但能源成本高企压制整体涨幅。中国市场方面，资金从港股ETF创纪录流出，转向A股AI硬件板块；上海楼市在政策托底下出现结构性反弹，而香港豪宅市场也初现复苏迹象。后续观察：美伊战争若持续，IEA警告全球原油储备可能在夏季降至“临界水平”，能源价格可能进一步推升全球通胀，打压消费与制造业。与此同时，AI竞赛进入“每瓦每用户价值”的深水区，巨头融资与资本开支竞赛将考验市场流动性。

- [OECD warns of global slowdown as U.S.-Iran war stymies economic growth prospects](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/oecd-warns-of-global-slowdown-as-iran-war-stymies-growth-prospects-.html) — OECD大幅下调全球经济展望，美伊冲突的“持久创伤”是主因。
- [U.S. proposes fresh tariffs on 60 economies over forced labor trade practices](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/us-tariffs-60-economies-dection-301-forced-labor-trade-practices-.html) — 美国贸易代表办公室提议对全球60个经济体加征301条款关税，税率10%-12.5%，贸易摩擦再度升级。
- [Euro Zone Inflation Climbs To 3.2% As Iran War Keeps Energy Prices Elevated](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxQdlZEQTI2NUZ1QkpCZmM1enZlNjNIT3lZM0RUTkR3TkhiOXNxUjB1V3V2M2UzSDE5bnRpbWtPYUV1YVBCbmJENm5pc011emJoOHBoS25wNzFEbFo3WEthSWZvbkxsOENZVkxES29LWUE5WWdDOHlZVnRPcDJpZkUyWTYyS2Nud0dYbEktWkpNckhzUlFqU1R6LUhDQU9DSW00) — 欧元区5月通胀升至3.2%，能源价格受伊朗战争推高，ECB加息预期骤然升温。
- [Bitcoin hits lowest since February as crypto competes for liquidity with blockbuster IPOs](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/bitcoin-crypto-ipos-market.html) — 比特币持续下跌至2月以来最低，大型IPO抽走市场流动性是核心原因。
- [Mainland-listed HK Stock ETFs See Record RMB25B Weekly Outflow](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPOHlsemljMkQ3SUhoOVJqZjBPaFZwV09oY0FhTXY5UHh3VmpqMzh2dlJ5bm1uWldRamhGQ0NveENVS21ZRmVXOXUwZTdKSUZfNE5wQXFHMlNtY290NDR4RXdSUk5seUZuQjRrdEwwZjc4ZzVpWS02TlRsRGtmNmdPS0h5X3J1bGJBbDZEcWZ4dEFsMXU4aEt2Y1o5Nm5NYkox) — 内地上市的港股ETF单周净流出250亿元人民币，创历史纪录，资金转向A股AI硬件。
- [Global oil stockpiles could fall to ‘critical levels’ by summer, IEA warns](https://www.scmp.com/economy/china-economy/article/3355796/global-oil-stockpiles-could-fall-critical-levels-summer-iea-warns) — IEA警告全球原油库存将在夏季降至“临界水平”，即便达成停火协议，能源危机也可能持续数月。
- [Goldman Sachs cuts Hong Kong stocks in favor of mainland China AI hardware plays](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQRUFXMGs1YzZkM0p1OXF4bWtxbWFrUm9Sa0RuV0xLZzRUV0lnOVI3Sm5wRTBQX3JKc0kwUXpCZXhOOE9fV3BYX2ZVWUc4QllkQ0p4Q2dUTVhteElIS09XOFVCWjRyVnJ4VWF2dEVhMG96UlEtRVBNVVVyUkVjazdwZmNrRmE) — 高盛调降港股评级，转超配A股AI硬件板块，反映市场对中国AI产业链的重新定价。

**后续观察：** 地缘政治风险是当前最关键的宏观变量。若美伊冲突升级导致油价突破关键阈值，全球通胀预期可能重新抬升，迫使各国央行在增长下行压力下仍被迫收紧。AI赛道虽持续吸金，但Alphabet 800亿美元天量融资计划与比特币等风险资产的资金争夺战，将考验市场风险偏好。中国方面，南下资金大撤退与A股AI题材的虹吸效应，可能进一步加剧港股流动性压力。
economy.en:
Global markets are navigating a complex landscape dominated by geopolitical conflict, monetary policy tightening, and accelerating AI investment. The OECD has slashed its growth forecast due to the U.S.-Iran war, while the IEA warns oil stockpiles could hit critical levels by summer. Meanwhile, the AI race is escalating with Alphabet's record $80B equity raise and SoftBank's massive European data center plans. China sees a capital rotation from Hong Kong to mainland AI plays, and Eurozone inflation has climbed to 3.2%, reinforcing ECB rate hike expectations. Commodity markets are mixed, with energy and agricultural products sensitive to conflict and weather.

- [OECD warns of global slowdown as U.S.-Iran war stymies economic growth prospects](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/oecd-warns-of-global-slowdown-as-iran-war-stymies-growth-prospects-.html) – The OECD cuts its global growth outlook, signaling lasting damage from the Middle East conflict.
- [Global oil stockpiles could fall to ‘critical levels’ by summer, IEA warns](https://www.scmp.com/economy/china-economy/article/3355796/global-oil-stockpiles-could-fall-critical-levels-summer-iea-warns) – The IEA warns of an energy crisis that could persist even if a ceasefire is reached.
- [U.S. proposes fresh tariffs on 60 economies over forced labor trade practices](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/us-tariffs-60-economies-dection-301-forced-labor-trade-practices-.html) – A 10% duty on economies with forced labor prohibitions, 12.5% on others.
- [Google owner Alphabet to sell $80bn in stock to fund AI spending spree](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jun/02/google-alphabet-sell-stock-ai-share-sale-berkshire-hathaway) – The largest equity fundraiser in history underscores the capital intensity of the AI boom.
- [Big Tech's AI ambitions pose a major power test for Europe](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/big-techs-ai-power-test-europe-softbank-france.html) – SoftBank plans 3.1 GW of AI data centers in France, highlighting energy challenges.
- [Euro Zone Inflation Climbs To 3.2% As Iran War Keeps Energy Prices Elevated](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxQdlZEQTI2NUZ1QkpCZmM1enZlNjNIT3lZM0RUTkR3TkhiOXNxUjB1V3V2M2UzSDE5bnRpbWtPYUV1YVBCbmJENm5pc011emJoOHBoS25wNzFEbFo3WEthSWZvbkxsOENZVkxES29LWUE5WWdDOHlZVnRPcDJpZkUyWTYyS2Nud0dYbEktWkpNckhzUlFqU1R6LUhDQU9DSW00) – The ECB is now widely expected to hike rates in June.
- [Chinese investors exit Hong Kong stocks as AI woos money onshore](https://news.google.) – Record weekly outflow from mainland-listed HK stock ETFs signals a shift to domestic AI hardware.

**Watch next:** ECB rate decision on June 6, weekly U.S. oil inventory data, and further details on Alphabet's AI capex deployment. The interplay between geopolitical risk and AI-driven tech spending will dominate sentiment.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻呈现三个显著特征：中东与东欧两场热战同步升级，平民伤亡与基础设施损毁加剧；亚洲市场在AI驱动下出现分化，日本股市创新高而韩国消费持续萎缩；中国社会聚焦教育革新与文化传播，同时中文互联网社区经历情怀与商业的碰撞。以下为关键动向：

- **中东战火延烧至海湾**：伊朗向科威特和巴林发射导弹，科威特国际机场遭重创、航班停飞，美军随即打击伊朗设施（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/03/g-s1-125566/iran-war-updates)）。此前伊朗已宣布不会交出浓缩铀，霍尔木兹海峡控制权博弈进入第96天（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/3/whats-happening-on-day-96-of-iran-war-as-us-iran-engage-in-new-attacks?traffic_source=rss)）。
- **俄乌战场再遭重创**：俄占克里米亚一巴士遭无人机击中致7死（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp3peyykxd5o)），俄军对基辅发动数月来最大规模空袭，平民损失惨重（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/sections/the-picture-show/2026/06/02/nx-s1-5844159/ukraine-kyiv-russia-drone-missile-strikes)）。普京虽态度强硬，但忠诚派也开始对战争持续表达担忧（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy82339793go)）。
- **日本股市飙涨背后的AI狂潮**：日经225首次突破68,000点，AI驱动的买盘持续涌入（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/3/japans-stock-market-hits-new-record-as-ai-boom-gathers-steam?traffic_source=rss)）；与此同时，日本拟从明年4月起对食品征收1%新税，或影响消费（[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNQnFhR1JUS0ZWZFdMSHR2T2RQMUV6MkhkRlNPY3J3UTM1d2E4N09jS1ozWE11T1loU2ZaTGZSQzh2VG1RM1V1YkJydV9aZ2tpVHRBOHowdzBkdTZyMThyWk9Xc2NsQkY4XzI1VkpUTFRNMlI0R2JVTXZSUWxOcG5ZNzk2MGxQZ25W)）。
- **中国教育科技融合加速**：复旦大学推出AI赋能教学新范式（[edu.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE8wY0dmWG1FdlZiX1gwaGJPQXR1ZzBRR0x1cjl1N0lQa0FRTWh6YURVbkczNHhTVnhRWWFPcGVPaUtSOUdabEoybWRHN3lUNFc4ZmZ6LXBfX0xoRFVWZ0xiNUJrSXMzVnVaLWZTbDlB)），高考季来临，高校多措并举新增特色专业（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxPUGpZcHhQX2d6eHMxQWw4dGczQ2pBSTVvQ1NfZWotT1dqeVZ2WDRRUDJjYUJrWF9wVUlSU2ktNFRySks1emFTY3ZQWEtRZ1BuNjBtSUh0VU80ZmNUQkFvVE1TZjN1OGoyV2E0aFhFOFNDZ0FldWdDZ1Z3TDg2b2ZLalAwQQ)）。
- **中文互联网社区情怀退潮**：天涯论坛重启前景黯淡，投资人被建议“留点养老钱”（[澎湃](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5OTE5HeEJkaHhuV1YzV3pOOWxmOVBHOGhqOFZfSzVnc21jZTJZMVZQcno5dG5aVU1Qd0t2Y3ZDR1R5eXRLZV9xcDZFNzlaS01kX21HSVNJSklDdldpdW5jdg)），分析指出情怀难以支撑商业，小红书与知乎的狂奔才是现实（[维科号](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE53b0ZsYlFWLXlUX1FQakRRRlBGNFRuZktiQUVuVkpNamJ0dkpJc2tLRzU3QmJaUGdwMmRrZmdDQkRnNE90TFluSFUxS1dsS0d6TzZFS3Vibw)）。

**后续观察**：伊朗战争的外溢效应已从波斯湾延伸至南亚——斯里兰卡经济因中东冲突再遭重创（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/02/nx-s1-5823430/global-conflicts-push-sri-lankas-economy-to-the-brink)）；而日韩正在酝酿军事后勤协定，可能改变东亚安全格局（[SCMP](https://news.google.)）。全球动荡中，中国派出医疗专家组支援刚果（金）抗击埃博拉（[人民网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1WT3FfVkhnaWlMXzdWY3NFLU5uTjhDVUR5VE51YlBzRGRqaHEzdGtlaEFiYTNWT2w3SldRd2h0Y1ZSM0dhNzg0Unlva3dWalVOM0JGUGlfMEExSDdEbFAwcDRuXzZTSDJ3c0trdw)），展现负责任大国角色。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been marked by an escalation in the Iran-US war, with Iranian missile strikes hitting Kuwait and Bahrain and US retaliatory strikes on Iranian facilities. The conflict continues to reshape global energy and security dynamics. Meanwhile, the Russia-Ukraine war shows no respite, with a drone strike on a bus in Russian-controlled Ukraine killing seven and a massive attack on Kyiv. Economic signals are mixed: Japan's Nikkei 225 surged past 68,000 for the first time on AI-driven buying, while Australia's economy slows and Sri Lanka teeters under conflict spillovers. In East Asia, South Korea and Japan are exploring a military logistics pact that could shift regional power balances. China's domestic news focuses on education reforms, AI in teaching, and cultural diplomacy, while the Chinese community platform Zhihu debates the fate of the once-iconic Tianya forum. Here are the key takeaways:

- **Iran-US war intensifies:** Iran fired missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain (NPR: [Iran fires missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain, U.S. strikes Iran facility](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/03/g-s1-125566/iran-war-updates)), damaging Kuwait's airport (BBC: [US and Iran launch new strikes, as Kuwait says airport hit by Iranian drones](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yx135yg53o)). The US struck an Iranian facility in response, and Secretary Rubio set a condition for lifting sanctions (Al Jazeera: [What’s happening on day 96 of Iran war](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/3/whats-happening-on-day-96-of-iran-war-as-us-iran-engage-in-new-attacks?traffic_source=rss)). The Strait of Hormuz remains a flashpoint.
- **Russia-Ukraine war grinds on:** A drone hit a bus in Russian-controlled Ukraine, killing seven (BBC: [Seven killed after drone hits bus in Russia-controlled part of Ukraine](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp3peyykxd5o)). Russia launched a massive attack on Kyiv overnight (NPR: [Scenes from the aftermath of Russia's latest massive attack on Kyiv](https://www.npr.org/sections/the-picture-show/2026/06/02/nx-s1-5844159/ukraine-kyiv-russia-drone-missile-strikes)). Public discourse inside Russia is showing signs of war fatigue even among Putin loyalists (BBC: [Putin remains uncompromising on Ukraine](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy82339793go)).
- **Japan's stock market hits record on AI boom:** The Nikkei 225 topped 68,000 for the first time (Al Jazeera: [Japan’s stock market hits new record as AI boom gathers steam](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/3/japans-stock-market-hits-new-record-as-ai-boom-gathers-steam?traffic_source=rss); Stamford Advocate via Google News: [Tokyo's Nikkei 225 index tops 68,000](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPXzVQWTRQNXVlWldWLWE0NzhodTdrUlU5LW8wMFd6eHd2TVV0Q09yaGFNRDByamNFZFZqZzMtRjZ4R3ZCLVBva2htQ3QySDN5MllJWW55dzJoRzhfZ3JkNlFmSFA1X0psM0J5alkyUTNoNFBpRW4xcWNycDJsTlNjbDlYMUVjd0hmSDlobmVmcF9JaEZHREF5M2FPb0Z4QUlxemVDc1ktWFA3WkJrVWNGVw)). The AI-driven buying frenzy shows no signs of slowing.
- **Australia's economy slowing:** Treasurer Jim Chalmers spun a positive narrative, but data shows the economy decelerated sharply in early 2026, with living standards falling (Guardian: [Jim Chalmers is putting a positive spin on the economy](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/03/australia-economic-outlook-economy-gdp-growth-jim-chalmers)). The Middle East conflict and rate hikes are biting.
- **South Korea and Japan eye military pact:** The two countries are considering a military logistics agreement, which could concern China (SCMP via Google News: [South Korea and Japan eye military logistics pact](https://news.google.)). This could reshape Asia's security architecture.
- **China dispatches medical team to DRC for Ebola:** China sent a medical expert team to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support Ebola control efforts (People's Daily via Google News: [中国抗疫医疗专家组抵达刚果（金）支援埃博拉防控](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1WT3FfVkhnaWlMXzdWY3NFLU5uTjhDVUR5VE51YlBzRGRqaHEzdGtlaEFiYTNWT2w3SldRd2h0Y1ZSM0dhNzg0Unlva3dWalVOM0JGUGlfMEExSDdEbFAwcDRuXzZTSDJ3c0trdw)). This aligns with China's global health diplomacy.
- **Shell accused over Nigeria pipeline pollution:** Documents show Shell pumped oil through a pipeline for years despite evidence of pollution (BBC: [Shell pumped oil through Nigeria pipeline for years despite pollution evidence](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdrp8v7407ro)). The company disputes the claims, citing contextual complexity.

**Watch next:** The Iran-US conflict is likely to escalate further, with potential disruption to global oil supply and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The South Korea-Japan military logistics pact could trigger a reaction from China and North Korea. Domestically, China's education reform and AI integration will continue to shape human capital development. On the community front, the debate over Tianya's revival signals shifting user loyalties in Chinese social media.

military.zh:
今日军事头条聚焦美伊冲突骤然升级。伊朗革命卫队宣布以导弹、无人机和海军力量打击美军及商船，科威特、巴林遭袭，美军中央司令部则对伊朗在格什姆岛的军事站点实施“自卫打击”，并拦截了多枚导弹。与此同时，俄军在乌克兰首次大规模使用“锆石”高超音速反舰导弹打击地面目标，乌克兰空军“幻影2000”疑似开始执行对地攻击任务。在印太，辽宁舰航母编队在菲律宾海一周内完成170架次起降，展示高强度战备能力。台海与南海方向，日本、菲律宾动作频频，中国官方密集回应。

- **美伊交火全面升级**：伊朗向科威特机场发射无人机并攻击巴林，美军拦截导弹并打击格什姆岛。BBC等多家媒体确认冲突有扩大迹象。[US and Iran launch new strikes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5IQlY0SWk3SW1lWWlyN19nN0VHNklGQ2xvVm04LU8zajZpWEZaOXVaWTk3YmZpRmFLYWUwQVc3T3pMMXc1dWdVZkdsVzVVajUzZllhN29aYVJJdw)
- **霍尔木兹海峡与红海双重威胁**：伊朗威胁封锁红海，美军“自卫打击”后更逼近海峡。纽约时报披露特朗普政府此前无视关于海峡的兵棋推演警告。[War Games and Warnings on Strait of Hormuz Went Unheeded](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQQmVueWFEN3JZaGctc3I2T0J3RmFFTlVSSWpiSTRRTE5xb1NIdnhZRHRTZGZ6bmdiNHlKcy1VdE01UklxVmNLeTY1Y3BzNHVQb29kbXROVm9yU2ZhMElBd2VHbE14ajNTWlVUVnNoLVVRd2FaUVY1cDdfekF1S2E3NnduSks3UQ)
- **俄军“锆石”导弹实战化**：俄罗斯使用“锆石”高超音速反舰导弹打击乌克兰城市，基辅防空压力骤增。[Russia uses Zircon hypersonic anti-ship missiles](https://news.google.)
- **乌克兰“幻影2000”疑似转战对地攻击**：低空突防后急剧爬升的飞行剖面暗示导弹攻击，法国军援飞机的作战范围扩大。[Are Ukrainian Mirage 2000s Now Flying Air-To-Ground Strike Missions?](https://www.twz.com/air/are-ukrainian-mirage-2000s-now-flying-air-to-ground-strike-missions)
- **辽宁舰航母编队高强度训练**：一周170架次起降，日本护卫舰持续监视，展现远海作战能力。[Chinese Carrier Strike Group Conducts 170 Sorties](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/02/chinese-carrier-strike-group-conducts-170-sorties-during-drills-in-philippine-sea)
- **美国宣布新钻地弹GBU-76**：取代“掩体粉碎弹”MOP，空军即将列装，针对深埋加固目标能力提升。[Next Generation Penetrator Bomb Slated To Replace MOP Has Been Designated GBU-76](https://www.twz.com/air/next-generation-penetrator-bomb-slated-to-replace-mop-has-been-designated-gbu-76)

**后续观察**：美伊冲突已从代理人战争转为直接交火，科威特和巴林的卷入意味着海湾安全格局被打破。伊朗威胁红海封锁将影响全球能源航运，国际油价大概率剧烈波动。中国南海台海方面，需关注日菲越界动作后大陆的实际管控措施。俄乌战场“锆石”导弹的实战应用可能迫使乌方重新部署防空资源。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have witnessed a dramatic and dangerous escalation in the Gulf region, with the United States and Iran trading direct strikes for the first time since the breakdown of ceasefire talks. This confrontation, centered on the Strait of Hormuz, has immediate implications for global energy security, military force posture, and the stability of key maritime chokepoints. Simultaneously, the PLA Navy continues high-tempo carrier operations in the Philippine Sea, while diplomatic tensions simmer in the Taiwan Strait and South China Sea. The confluence of these events demands close attention to both the immediate tactical picture and the longer-term strategic ripple effects.

- **US and Iran exchange direct strikes:** The US conducted self-defense strikes on an Iranian military ground control station on Qeshm Island, followed by Iran launching missile and drone attacks against Kuwait and Bahrain. US forces intercepted several Iranian missiles and drones. The strikes mark a significant escalation, with Iran claiming hits on a commercial vessel and US forces. [BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5IQlY0SWk3SW1lWWlyN19nN0VHNklGQ2xvVm04LU8zajZpWEZaOXVaWTk3YmZpRmFLYWUwQVc3T3pMMXc1dWdVZkdsVzVVajUzZllhN29aYVJJdw), [Kurdistan24](https://news.google.), [Stars and Stripes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPbjFGRWZIaG9zN1ZvazVNbnZtcjJvNFVPamVCd1JSOTNqNjEwaXpxVk5MRVI5UTVVTDFQMVJBdnZzSVhxdG1vaFY2ak1URXd2VzZFTlVzMWxOT21jV1NOemNBdmxFcXFyUU9tdVJrWEd4VWM1TnI4QTk2RjY2cTN6ci1KS3F6RnRPYWpXS0JRODd2WE83RUdYOTFxTXFVaVNKam1POEJ2QlMwSFE)

- **Strait of Hormuz chokepoint under threat:** The escalation has directly endangered the Strait of Hormuz, through which about 20% of global oil passes. Iran has threatened a Red Sea blockade, and alternative routes are under discussion. The disruption is already reshuffling shipping markets and energy security calculations. [EnergyNow.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNNE1fMzFiSjhrOFpJV21kajdMYkJEd20zcGM4Sm0yREpWU09IZnBwX0VyUk9LTWlHYWhDYXZCOS04eng0d1lPdVlKX2pZUjFwYzAwZkM4NWlDazVaSUFfRHlLaTczenpiZTdrb0lXd09XZTRiWHpNVGYxcDRjaHhoZ3JvcVFtb1VZM29raVc4RE9kUXBZWVdkbmktRU5FbV9hb1Fweg), [IndexBox](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPWWthc2ltNF9pdE1qYXFDaDdiSUl3X29EQWVQOWJqUVpBNGNGUjQ0MHRMQUVkamtoWG80T25HRDlBNEFVbHdLWUs2QXMxbEhnNFdmdk1BemFWejRSanBuMUYxLUVFMF9KNGl5RjRzbUFtQUVleFpsZUpaN3FuaGVCRnd4V1UzSG1SMHlSZWFMLWJBZHA5Vnc)

- **US munitions depletion and replenishment concerns:** The rapid expenditure of precision munitions in the Gulf and Ukraine raises urgent questions about US stockpile depth. Analysts are asking how long replenishment will take, especially given simultaneous support for Israel and Ukraine. [Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/how-long-will-it-take-to-replenish-the-us-militarys-munitions-stockpiles/)

- **China’s PLAN carrier strike group conducts 170 sorties in Philippine Sea:** The Liaoning CSG has been operating east of Luzon, with Japanese destroyer tracking. The high sortie rate demonstrates China’s increasing carrier capability and operational tempo in a critical maritime domain. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/02/chinese-carrier-strike-group-conducts-170-sorties-during-drills-in-philippine-sea)

- **Taiwan Strait rhetoric escalates:** Australia released a report warning of a potential crisis in the Taiwan Strait, which China’s Taiwan Affairs Office dismissed as “unpopular.” Taiwan’s President Lai Ching-te pledged to maintain peace, and US Secretary of State Rubio expressed a desire to maintain the status quo. [China Review](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBqcVRRQjZOU0pQMmV4QkxkeWgtU0Jwdk5rRFJ2NWVkSmlGZ3lxbkFEb3ZpMHRFeFdRblVWd0RXdlJpaEJ6ZTBGNGRFazJfZVNKRmg1TWk1TkR0N1pYaDZxcHEyQ0RUbTltczRIZw), [Voice of America](https://news.google.)

- **Russia intensifies hypersonic strikes in Ukraine, while internal pressure mounts:** Russia used Zircon hypersonic anti-ship missiles against Ukrainian cities, adding to air defense pressure. Meanwhile, Russian elites are reportedly pushing to end the war due to economic strain. [Defence Industry Europe](https://news.google.), [MSN](https://news.google.)

**Watch next:** The immediate trajectory of US-Iran hostilities will be the dominant driver of risk across energy markets, Gulf security, and broader Middle East stability. Monitor whether Iran expands attacks to include Red Sea shipping or targets US allies more directly. Also watch for any Chinese reactions to the Taiwan Strait report and continued PLAN carrier activity. The US munitions replenishment timeline and any new diplomatic moves by the Trump administration will be critical signals.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现三大主线：电动汽车市场在海外与商用领域找到新增量，科技产品社会影响引发监管反思，AI行业在微软Build大会后加速但面临内外部规则博弈。

- **汽车**：Tesla Cybertruck在北美需求滑坡之际，意外获[哈萨克斯坦紧急服务部门采购](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/tesla-cybertruck-kazakhstan-emergency-services/)，证明极端工况实用性可打开利基市场；Orange EV拿下[600辆电动重卡订单](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/orange-ev-scores-record-600-unit-order-as-demand-for-electric-semi-trucks-soars/)，凸显物流业电气化不受补贴波动影响；BYD披露[铸造铝合金框架](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/byd-says-its-cast-aluminum-frame-is-lighter-tougher-and-safer-than-steel/)减重百磅且通过12吨测试，技术路线挑战传统钢材；纽约州起诉内政部[10亿美元贿赂石油公司](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/new-york-sues-over-interior-dept-s-1b-bribe-to-an-oil-company-stop-wind-power/)叫停风电，清洁能源与化石燃料博弈白热化；Subaru[新电动SUV上市两月即超越Solterra销量](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/subarus-new-evs-already-outselling-solterra/)，产品力差异决定市场成败。

- **科技产品**：索尼State of Play压轴公布[《战神：劳菲》](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/941516/god-of-war-laufey-ps5-trailer)，PS5生命周期后期大作策略稳健；波兰政府批准[校园手机及智能手表禁令](https://www.engadget.com/2186323/poland-classroom-phone-ban-online-porn-age-check-bills/)，欧洲数字监管再收紧；Uber公布[数千件无人车遗留物品](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/squishmallows-dentures-and-an-i-heart-hot-dads-bag-uber-has-found-thousands-of-items-left-in-robotaxis/)，从Squishmallows到假牙，侧面反映服务已常态化但运营细节待完善；Meta允许员工[从追踪程序休息30分钟](https://www.engadget.com/2186261/meta-will-reportedly-let-employees-take-30-minute-breaks-from-its-tracking-program/)，职场监控争议再升温。

- **AI**：Microsoft Build 2026发布[七大公告](https://www.theverge.com/tech/941738/microsoft-build-2026-biggest-announcements)，包括全天候个人助理和新Surface硬件，生态粘性增强；特朗普政府被曝[内部对AI监管立场对立](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNREtSUDhhcVBDX3hpa3ZKbDg4VzRrMzNVSk1XaTNCcjltVUpFaDZZN0EtTFZFSjI3SXJGVEVGREJDb3Jtb184aThoMXVFNEtGSHZyWXFfUmRrZ0tDWnVqZmFab0VIVzVJVWFndkQ1UHo2TFdjcUNqUFB3cGVUakZZTjJRYWpFTGlfNjVIVU5RSVVLd3AxSGpUM3c5OWpEWW8)，联邦法案进程存变数；Google允许[网站退出AI搜索结果](https://www.engadget.com/2186257/google-will-allow-websites-to-exclude-themselves-from-ai-search-results/)，英国媒体率先获此选项，内容版权博弈催生新规则；AI教父Yoshua Bengio等[涌入创业圈](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE12dWQweVVQQ1VUNmhqUFJmSE82UnI3NWlCRGV3M0IxVG9ZSGJtYmQtMV96Uy0wektubUY2SGVKalFwR29aNzFnSHBrUFpHUjFteE9R)，硅谷押注下一代范式；MIT Tech Review发布[小企业AI应用指南](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/06/02/1138227/how-small-businesses-can-leverage-ai/)，降低AI落地门槛。

**后续观察**：未来一周需关注特斯拉Q2交付数据（Cybertruck国内是否继续下滑）、微软新款Surface市场反响、美国联邦AI监管法案能否在国会取得实质进展。同时，英国媒体退出Google AI摘要的后续影响可能引发其他地区效仿，改变搜索生态格局。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape sees electric vehicles expanding into new markets and heavy-duty fleets, while AI regulation and adoption face internal conflicts and new opt-out mechanisms. Meanwhile, gaming and consumer electronics bring notable announcements.

- **Tesla Cybertruck** finds a new international buyer as Kazakhstan's emergency services order additional units after successful rescue operations in Almaty, even as US demand drops. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/tesla-cybertruck-kazakhstan-emergency-services/)
- **Orange EV** scores a record 600-unit single order for electric Class 8 terminal trucks, signaling that heavy-duty EV demand remains strong without federal incentives. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/orange-ev-scores-record-600-unit-order-as-demand-for-electric-semi-trucks-soars/)
- **BYD** claims its cast aluminum frame for the Yangwang U8L is lighter and tougher than steel, passing a 12-ton lift test. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/byd-says-its-cast-aluminum-frame-is-lighter-tougher-and-safer-than-steel/)
- **Subaru's new EVs** are already outselling the Solterra just two months after launch, indicating stronger consumer acceptance. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/subarus-new-evs-already-outselling-solterra/)
- **Google and UK media groups** strike a deal allowing publishers to opt out of AI search summaries, a precedent likely to spread. [Read more](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/03/uk-media-groups-power-opt-out-google-ai-search-summaries) and [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2186257/google-will-allow-websites-to-exclude-themselves-from-ai-search-results/)
- **Microsoft Build 2026** unveils an always-on AI personal assistant, new Surface hardware, and updates to its in-house AI models. [Read more](https://www.theverge.com/tech/941738/microsoft-build-2026-biggest-announcements)
- **Sony** reveals *God of War Laufey* for PS5 at its State of Play event, but no release date given. [Read more](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/941516/god-of-war-laufey-ps5-trailer)
- **Poland** approves a bill to ban phones and smartwatches in schools, a major move in digital policy. [Read more](https://www.engadget.com/2186323/poland-classroom-phone-ban-online-porn-age-check-bills/)

**Watch next:** Monitor how Google's opt-out mechanism affects publisher traffic and revenue, and track Cybertruck's international adoption as US domestic demand softens.

sports.zh: 今日体育板块焦点聚焦欧洲足坛转会市场巨变：曼联以3500万英镑敲定亚特兰大中场埃德森，利物浦则迅速与安多尼·伊劳拉达成口头协议接替被解雇的斯洛特，两笔交易可能重塑英超中游格局。与此同时，国际足联官宣2026世界杯将启用全新越位技术，取消延迟举旗，这或彻底改变比赛节奏与防守策略。羽毛球方面，印尼公开赛次日国羽多人出战，王祉怡迎战杨佳敏，贾一凡/张殊贤组合受关注；虎扑社区因CBA总决赛古德温压哨绝杀广厦而沸腾，该球成为CBA总决赛历史首次压哨绝杀；此外杨瀚森在模拟选秀中预测首轮第16顺位，引发国内篮球圈热议。后续观察：利物浦新帅伊劳拉的战术适应性、曼联新援能否填补中场空缺、CBA总决赛后续走势以及国羽在印尼公开赛的淘汰赛表现。
sports.en:
The past 24 hours delivered a flurry of major sports developments across football, basketball, and badminton. In European football, Liverpool moved swiftly to replace Arne Slot with Andoni Iraola, while Manchester United agreed a £35m deal for Atalanta midfielder Ederson. The CBA Finals produced a historic first buzzer-beater, and the Indonesia Open badminton tournament saw Chinese shuttlers advance. Meanwhile, FIFA unveiled new offside technology for the 2026 World Cup, and F1's Monaco Grand Prix looms with Ferrari tipped as favourites. Here are the key stories:

- **Liverpool appoint Andoni Iraola** – The club reached a verbal agreement with the Bournemouth manager to succeed Arne Slot, marking a significant managerial shift ([Liverpool agree deal with Iraola](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4gv1ydm4yro)).
- **Man Utd secure Ederson** – Brazilian midfielder Ederson is set to become Michael Carrick's first signing after a £35m deal was agreed with Atalanta ([Man Utd agree £35m fee for Atalanta's Ederson](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c78q2dxv89go)).
- **FIFA introduces semi-automated offside tech** – The delayed flag may soon vanish as new tracking technology is approved for the 2026 World Cup ([No more delayed flag? Fifa adds new offside tech for World Cup](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c232d34kkyzo)).
- **CBA Finals history made** – Goodwin's buzzer-beater gave his team a win over Guangsha, the first last-second game-winner in CBA Finals history ([古德温压哨绝杀广厦](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBreHVjdjRxUld3QzV4anhjLXZueWtIbWhKcGszYUY5SkZVak54clNVUjExTFZTdXlXUUVvRXZJX1d4andXUGdHMXQyazdSaFhGZUhFYXRZUmo3alVSOVJNeHZ5QUgxLVpMX3BiN2FwUmRJdEdfQjhr)).
- **Indonesia Open badminton under way** – Chinese players Wang Zhiyi and Jia Yifan competed on Day 2; Wang Zhiyi faced Yang Jiamin ([印尼公开赛赛程](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9oZEJ2a0NMbnJRc1lvSEdWZjZ3dXBhQllqbm9jNzQ1blpkenJpbkVENDlWZkE4bUxXQl83dXduY0ljNG9XeDlhOWRTMlhXUVl5X2YtLTRCVzZVNW9ZRkJ4QlNwZw)).
- **F1: Ferrari tipped for Monaco glory** – Rivals see Ferrari as favourites for the Monaco GP, with Hamilton and Leclerc both eyeing victory ([Can Hamilton beat Leclerc if Ferrari live up to Monaco 'favourites' tag?](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13549132/why-ferrari-are-being-tipped-as-monaco-grand-prix-favourites-by-f1-rivals-as-lewis-hamilton-charles-leclerc-eye-glory)).
- **Tennis: Kostyuk dedicates win to Ukraine** – Marta Kostyuk beat compatriot Svitolina to reach the French Open semi-finals, the first Ukrainian woman to do so ([I want to give this match to Ukraine](https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/articles/clypkqpe3d2o)).

**Watch next:** The Monaco Grand Prix (June 7) will test Ferrari's early-season dominance, while the CBA Finals continue and the Indonesia Open badminton tournament reaches its knockout stages. Football transfer activity is expected to accelerate ahead of the summer window.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐新闻板块呈现多领域交叉碰撞：欧美方面，真人秀明星参选洛杉矶市长竟领先、CBS王牌新闻节目因裁员引爆价值观争议、Netflix续集集体遇冷；日韩K-pop销售纪录不断刷新，韩剧新作预告密集发布；微博社区围绕撞脸、生日互动与综艺名场面展开热议；中国影视则迎来现实主义票房奇迹与AI出海的双重信号。以下为详细动态。

- [Scott Pelley Fires Back After ’60 Minutes’ Ouster: ‘The Collapse of Values at The Top Has Become Untenable’](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/scott-pelley-fires-back-60-minuter-ouster-collapse-of-value-1236765524/) — 资深记者Pelley被CBS News解雇后公开指责管理层“无能且不专业”，标志传统新闻伦理与资本主导的媒体改革正面冲突。
- [It’s Bass Vs. Pratt: Early L.A. Mayor Election Results Leaning Towards Incumbent Against ‘Hills’ Villain In The Fall](https://deadline.com/2026/06/spencer-pratt-karen-bass-l-a-mayor-election-results-runoff-1236939564/) — 《好莱坞女孩》反派Spencer Pratt在洛杉矶市长初选中意外领先，与现任市长Karen Bass进入第二轮，政治娱乐化的典型样本。
- [‘The Four Seasons’ & ‘A Good Girl’s Guide To Murder’ Extend Netflix’s Sophomore Viewership Slump](https://deadline.com/2026/06/four-seasons-good-girls-guide-to-murder-s2-premiere-viewership-1236939594/) — Netflix两部热门剧第二季开播收视大幅下滑，流媒体内容疲劳警报再响。
- [TREASURE Breaks Their 1st-Day Sales Record + Tops iTunes Charts Worldwide With “NEW WAV”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845353wpp/treasure-breaks-their-1st-day-sales-record-tops-itunes-charts-worldwide-with-new-wav) — TREASURE首日销量59万张创新高，韩流实体市场韧性仍强。
- [票房破14亿，《给阿嬷的情书》或许是中国影视文化战略转型的开始](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNMjl5cjdFS0RHM1MyUTZhcFcwSzVQRl9mOW5HVGZqaHJvaFlLaDllQUxUREdoZF94THBGVE85VTM4d0VsUG5oS05iSVFTTjdGcF9fTDAxaUY2dzQyVDJIRXE2dWNpUjQ5NWVncVg3a04zdWZ2Q3pZeG9SQ1c1dHZjekN1TWNQRUE2NElN) — 该片以无明星阵容拿下14亿，被评论视为中国现实主义影视转型的标志性事件。
- [周星驰进军AI产业 网封“娱乐圈黄仁勋”](https://news.google.) — 星爷跨界AI，突显中国顶级娱乐人向科技赛道转型的趋势。

**后续观察：** 洛杉矶市长选举与加州州长初选结果将对好莱坞政治影响力版图产生直接作用，需关注Spencer Pratt的真人秀动员能力是否持续；Netflix的“第二季魔咒”若无法打破，将倒逼平台调整原创策略；中国《给阿嬷的情书》的票房长尾效应和戛纳AI成果发布，可能成为下半年行业风向标。
entertainment.en:
Entertainment news over the past 24 hours has been dominated by major media shakeups, surprising political crossovers, and strong market signals in both K-pop and Chinese cinema. The firing of veteran journalist Scott Pelley from '60 Minutes' has sparked a fierce public backlash against CBS News leadership, while reality TV star Spencer Pratt's strong performance in the Los Angeles mayoral primary has stunned observers. In streaming, Netflix's sophomore slump deepens as two hit series fail to replicate their first-season viewership. Meanwhile, K-pop acts TREASURE and XLOV smash sales records, and Chinese director Stephen Chow announces an AI pivot. Below are the key developments.

- **Fired '60 Minutes' correspondent Scott Pelley** accused CBS News of a 'collapse of values' after his termination, calling new management 'incompetent' and 'unprofessional'. The ouster follows a tense meeting with incoming executive producer Nick Bilton. ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/scott-pelley-60-minutes-firing-cbs-response-1235571526/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/scott-pelley-fires-back-60-minuter-ouster-collapse-of-value-1236765524/), [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/scott-pelley-cbs-news-firing-statement-bari-weiss-1236612393/))
- **Reality TV personality Spencer Pratt** surged in early L.A. mayoral primary returns, positioning him for a November runoff against incumbent Karen Bass. The race has been called 'bizarre' by multiple outlets. 美股.en:
U.S. equity markets are at record highs but face headwinds from geopolitical tensions and trade policy. The OECD's growth downgrade due to the Iran war and new U.S. tariffs on 60 economies add uncertainty. Meanwhile, the AI arms race intensifies: Perplexity's CEO defines the winning metric as 'value per watt per user,' Alphabet is raising $80B in equity for AI infrastructure, and SoftBank is building massive data centers in Europe. Bitcoin dropped to its lowest since February as IPO demand siphons liquidity. Investors are increasingly betting on humanoid robots as the next frontier.

- [OECD warns of global slowdown as U.S.-Iran war stymies economic growth prospects](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/oecd-warns-of-global-slowdown-as-iran-war-stymies-growth-prospects-.html)
- [U.S. proposes fresh tariffs on 60 economies over forced labor trade practices](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/us-tariffs-60-economies-dection-301-forced-labor-trade-practices-.html)

- [Investors bet humanoid robots will transform industry and homes over the next decade](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/humanoid-robots-trillion-dollar-ai-market.html)
- [Bitcoin hits lowest since February as crypto competes for liquidity with blockbuster IPOs](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/bitcoin-crypto-ipos-market.html)

The market is caught between AI-fueled optimism and macro-economic drags. Watch for reactions to the ECB decision and U.S. CPI data next week.

Goldman Sachs cut Hong Kong stocks and maintained an overweight on A-shares. Beijing is also tightening retail access to U.S. stocks, benefiting local brokerages. Meanwhile, Haagen-Dazs's China business is being revamped by lemon tea chain Ningji, and CK Asset resumed luxury home sales in Hong Kong.

同花顺社区动态.en:
Commodity futures showed mixed moves in today's session. Rapeseed oil led gains, rising 3.94% on geopolitical supply concerns, while glass inched up 0.38% as analysts pointed to medium-term cost support from the Middle East conflict. In contrast, corn fell 0.95% on weak demand expectations, and iron ore dropped 0.57% amid steel sector headwinds. Cotton edged up 0.31% due to India's delayed monsoon, and pure soda ash declined 0.91% in sympathy with coking coal.

欧美.zh:
中东与东欧两线冲突同时加剧：伊朗导弹袭击科威特机场导致航班瘫痪，美军报复性打击伊朗设施；俄罗斯对基辅发动数月来最大规模空袭，俄占克里米亚一巴士遭无人机击中致7死。能源巨头Shell因尼日利亚管道污染隐瞒证据而遭曝光。此外，失踪数月的新泽西州共和党议员Kean Jr.在特朗普背书下赢得初选，折射美国政治怪象。

- 伊朗战争外溢：科威特机场遭伊朗无人机严重损坏，交通中断（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yx135yg53o)）；美军回应打击伊朗设施（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/03/g-s1-125566/iran-war-updates)）。
- 俄乌战场：俄军无人机击中克里米亚方向巴士致7死（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp3peyykxd5o)）；基辅一夜遭遇猛烈空袭，平民伤亡严重（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/sections/the-picture-show/2026/06/02/nx-s1-5844159/ukraine-kyiv-russia-drone-missile-strikes)）。
- 环境丑闻：Shell被曝在尼日利亚明知管道污染仍持续运行多年（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdrp8v7407ro)）。
- 政治奇观：失踪多月的共和党议员Kean Jr.在特朗普背书后赢得初选（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y7nnjlrd5o)）。

收束：欧美板块的冲突连锁反应正在重塑中东和东欧安全格局，而国内政治与商业丑闻则提醒各方：战争之外的“软风险”同样不可忽视。
欧美.en:
The Europe and Americas desk is dominated by the Iran-US war escalation, the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict, and economic fallout. Iranian missile strikes on Kuwait and Bahrain drew US retaliation, while Russia continues brutal attacks on Ukraine. Economic news includes Australia's slowing growth, Japan's record stock market, and Sri Lanka's crisis. Notable also: a missing US congressman wins primary, and Shell faces pollution allegations in Nigeria.

- **Iran-US war**: Iran fired missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain; US struck an Iranian facility (NPR: [Iran fires missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/03/g-s1-125566/iran-war-updates)). Kuwait's airport was damaged (BBC: [US and Iran launch new strikes](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yx135yg53o)). Secretary Rubio said sanctions relief only if Iran gives up enriched uranium (Al Jazeera: [Day 96 of Iran war](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/3/whats-happening-on-day-96-of-iran-war-as-us-iran-engage-in-new-attacks?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Russia-Ukraine**: Drone strike on bus kills 7 in Russian-controlled Ukraine (BBC: [Seven killed after drone hits bus](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp3peyykxd5o)). Overnight massive attack on Kyiv (NPR: [Scenes from aftermath](https://www.npr.org/sections/the-picture-show/2026/06/02/nx-s1-5844159/ukraine-kyiv-russia-drone-missile-strikes)). War fatigue in Russia is growing (BBC: [Putin remains uncompromising](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy82339793go)).
- **Global economic spillovers**: Australia's economy slows sharply (Guardian: [Jim Chalmers spin](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/03/australia-economic-outlook-economy-gdp-growth-jim-chalmers)). Sri Lanka pushed to brink by global conflicts (NPR: [Global conflicts push Sri Lanka](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/02/nx-s1-5823430/global-conflicts-push-sri-lankas-economy-to-the-brink)). Japan's Nikkei hits record on AI (Al Jazeera: [Japan stock market record](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/3/japans-stock-market-hits-new-record-as-ai-boom-gathers-steam?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Miscellaneous**: Missing congressman Tom Kean Jr wins primary after Trump endorsement (BBC: [Mysteriously missing congressman wins primary](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y7nnjlrd5o)). Shell accused of Nigeria pollution (BBC: [Shell pumped oil through pipeline](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdrp8v7407ro)). Cricket Canada suspended over gang-linked corruption (Guardian: [Cricket Canada suspended](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/02/cricket-canada-suspension)).

**Signal to watch:** The Iran-US strikes may widen the conflict zone to the Gulf, with direct impact on oil prices and global shipping. The missing congressman's primary win raises governance questions.

日韩.zh:
日韩关系出现微妙转向：双方正探讨签署军事后勤协定，可能引发中国警惕；日本外交蓝皮书被指“降级”对华定位，中日关系再添变数。经济面，日经225在AI热潮中突破68,000点，但日本政府拟对食品开征1%消费税，内需承压；韩国酒类消费连续10个季度下滑，折射消费降级。

- 军事合作：日韩推进后勤协议，专家提醒中国需警惕（[SCMP](https://news.google.)）。
- 外交姿态：日本在《外交蓝皮书》中“降级”中国表述（[ThinkChina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPMm9kSHd6TFlDc1JKaFByNjJxRnBOQXB2TEZ1Um5oQVJBR09NdVJqWExWREdGX1daZGo1bzN0d2dGTDJjZnJVUGZVQmlna0hxcW5yak1vTW1IcFBVVEVlV29ZNVdIS25BcWRDLVBkSlRTRTJfRjk4U1pXa0hSYWo0X0ZKYW9uSTBlemlOclRwSHFrMGc)）。
- 股市与经济：日经225首破68,000点，AI买入热潮不减（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/6/3/japans-stock-market-hits-new-record-as-ai-boom-gathers-steam?traffic_source=rss)）；日本拟2027年4月开征食品1%消费税（[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNQnFhR1JUS0ZWZFdMSHR2T2RQMUV6MkhkRlNPY3J3UTM1d2E4N09jS1ozWE11T1loU2ZaTGZSQzh2VG1RM1V1YkJydV9aZ2tpVHRBOHowdzBkdTZyMThyWk9Xc2NsQkY4XzI1VkpUTFRNMlI0R2JVTXZSUWxOcG5ZNzk2MGxQZ25W)）。
- 消费降级：韩国家庭酒类月均支出降至13,000韩元，连续10个季度下降（[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFBVTXFWbUhDbkZfNV9aT2J4b21icHcwVzVwSjFwWjQ1bEE1MGt0QU1hNmZVWVpuSzMwRS1wWkowYmZFd0UwWnNnNzROUXdGclF4WXJxT1NKMA)）。

收束：日韩在安全与经济上呈现“外热内冷”分化——外部协同加速，内需却显露疲态，下一步需关注食品税对日本家庭的实际冲击及韩国地方选举后的政策走向。
日韩.en:
The Japan and Korea desk features a mix of geopolitical, economic, and social stories. Most notably, South Korea and Japan are exploring a military logistics pact that could alarm China, while Japan's Diplomatic Bluebook appears to downgrade China. Japan's stock market hit a record high, driven by AI. Domestically, Japan is considering a 1% tax on food, and South Korea held local elections with implications for governance.

- **Military pact**: South Korea and Japan eye a military logistics agreement; analysts ask if China should be wary (SCMP via Google News: [South Korea and Japan eye military logistics pact](https://news.google.)).
- **Japan downgrades China in Diplomatic Bluebook**: Japan's latest Diplomatic Bluebook reportedly downgrades China's status, signaling a shift in bilateral ties (ThinkChina via Google News: [Did Japan just ‘downgrade’ China?](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPMm9kSHd6TFlDc1JKaFByNjJxRnBOQXB2TEZ1Um5oQVJBR09NdVJqWExWREdGX1daZGo1bzN0d2dGTDJjZnJVUGZVQmlna0hxcW5yak1vTW1IcFBVVEVlV29ZNVdIS25BcWRDLVBkSlRTRTJfRjk4U1pXa0hSYWo0X0ZKYW9uSTBlemlOclRwSHFrMGc)).
- **Stock market record**: Tokyo's Nikkei 225 topped 68,000 for the first time, driven by AI hype (Stamford Advocate via Google News: [Tokyo's Nikkei 225 index tops 68,000](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPXzVQWTRQNXVlWldWLWE0NzhodTdrUlU5LW8wMFd6eHd2TVV0Q09yaGFNRDByamNFZFZqZzMtRjZ4R3ZCLVBva2htQ3QySDN5MllJWW55dzJoRzhfZ3JkNlFmSFA1X0psM0J5alkyUTNoNFBpRW4xcWNycDJsTlNjbDlYMUVjd0hmSDlobmVmcF9JaEZHREF5M2FPb0Z4QUlxemVDc1ktWFA3WkJrVWNGVw)).
- **Japan considers 1% food tax**: The Takaichi administration is considering a 1% tax on food from next April (Japan Times: [Takaichi administration considering 1% tax on food](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNQnFhR1JUS0ZWZFdMSHR2T2RQMUV6MkhkRlNPY3J3UTM1d2E4N09jS1ozWE11T1loU2ZaTGZSQzh2VG1RM1V1YkJydV9aZ2tpVHRBOHowdzBkdTZyMThyWk9Xc2NsQkY4XzI1VkpUTFRNMlI0R2JVTXZSUWxOcG5ZNzk2MGxQZ25W)).
- **South Korea local elections**: South Korea held June 3 local elections; results could signal political trends (Korea Herald: [What to know about South Korea's June 3 local elections](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFBVeVdvb0hzRGFhemlnMkpUN0lBc1JKS3c2VnZ1a3h2Nk9nQ1VGMGhnQU9hNXBuZnFpLUlGYmF5ZGI3SkJ4bDZUd2ZnZW0xaW8tX2w3QjY0aw)).

**Signal to watch:** The military logistics pact and diplomatic downgrade indicate a hardening of Japan-South Korea alignment against China. The food tax proposal will test public tolerance in Japan.

中国.zh:
中国社会新闻今日以教育、文化与国际合作为主线：复旦大学推出AI赋能教学新范式，高考季高校新增特色专业；三星堆红玉髓研究揭示青铜时代交流网络；中国抗疫医疗专家组赴刚果（金）支援埃博拉防控。同时，“剧纪联动”探索影视传播新路径，全球视野下中国文化讨论持续升温。

- AI+教育：复旦大学用AI赋能教与学，解锁教育新范式（[edu.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE8wY0dmWG1FdlZiX1gwaGJPQXR1ZzBRR0x1cjl1N0lQa0FRTWh6YURVbkczNHhTVnhRWWFPcGVPaUtSOUdabEoybWRHN3lUNFc4ZmZ6LXBfX0xoRFVWZ0xiNUJrSXMzVnVaLWZTbDlB)）。
- 高考季：华东理工大学新增多个特色专业，培养通道多元（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxPUGpZcHhQX2d6eHMxQWw4dGczQ2pBSTVvQ1NfZWotT1dqeVZ2WDRRUDJjYUJrWF9wVUlSU2ktNFRySks1emFTY3ZQWEtRZ1BuNjBtSUh0VU80ZmNUQkFvVE1TZjN1OGoyV2E0aFhFOFNDZ0FldWdDZ1Z3TDg2b2ZLalAwQQ)）。
- 考古：三星堆出土红玉髓揭示中国青铜时代跨区域交流（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOdEhBSVBUMmpIM1JhdVY0TktjelB6MzkzVzhWUW1CNGhGRDdhUktJb25EanVzY3NmM05aTmVxSnZwRlhueW9zaFdzSkhtLTRFSmhja2Y5dHAxcldDclo3VW5fZkUtQkVOT3hxSS1PQ2h3VzZ6ZXM2TFdjTnpUXy1id0JsNnlsOXc)）。
- 国际人道主义：中国抗疫医疗专家组抵达刚果（金）支援埃博拉防控（[人民网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1WT3FfVkhnaWlMXzdWY3NFLU5uTjhDVUR5VE51YlBzRGRqaHEzdGtlaEFiYTNWT2w3SldRd2h0Y1ZSM0dhNzg0Unlva3dWalVOM0JGUGlfMEExSDdEbFAwcDRuXzZTSDJ3c0trdw)）。
- 文化产业：剧集与纪录片联动推动影视传播新范式（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxPTy1kdjhDdFlpWFdvOGpXbjlfaG8wVGh6SzhfV1lvaFFuYThOSi1nOU82eDZRSVd2UlJrTXk0LXNtT2dfMko5V05Sb0h3NUxJNFJ6OVE2MkUwUTU1Q1hlWm1jUnoxVVdNT2stQmhQUWZkNmtoakdJODBPNUtCeE0zMHM0Zw)）。

收束：中国社会在科技赋能传统领域的同时，积极承担全球卫生治理责任，三星堆等考古发现则持续丰富文明叙事，民生为本的讨论（[hnzy.gov.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE5SeTJTWTFxUUViakhzcHUwc1pEc21zeHJfZXhpb2dSdVRXclVXUTZtZGpIUVgwY2ZXZHBObFhkZW9SQndmcU9oT045aDBvT1cwYzlVcDlCSHVpUnZlbmpiVHd0VHQ)）为政策走向提供理论注脚。
中国.en:
China's domestic news this cycle is heavy on education, culture, and international engagement. Major themes include AI in education, career guidance reforms, and cultural diplomacy. China also dispatched a medical team to the DRC for Ebola. Notable cultural and archaeological stories include Sanxingdui artifacts revealing Bronze Age interactions. There is no major domestic political crisis or economic shock in this window.

- **AI in education**: Fudan University is using AI to empower teaching and learning, showcasing a new paradigm for education (edu.cn via Google News: [解锁教育新范式！复旦大学这样用AI赋能教与学](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE8wY0dmWG1FdlZiX1gwaGJPQXR1ZzBRR0x1cjl1N0lQa0FRTWh6YURVbkczNHhTVnhRWWFPcGVPaUtSOUdabEoybWRHN3lUNFc4ZmZ6LXBfX0xoRFVWZ0xiNUJrSXMzVnVaLWZTbDlB)).
- **Career education conference**: A national career education exchange meeting was held in Guangzhou, focusing on life planning (SCNU News via Google News: [2026年生涯教育交流会](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiREFVX3lxTFA0RWRFZkxlMmZvek9OdldoNk5LMWxHSmpVa0E0akVEUmdDbU4wM3lMY0FuTjFQTkxyblVZZEdSU0VrdFhu)).
- **Cultural diplomacy salon**: A salon on 'Global Vision of Chinese Culture Integration and Contribution' was held in Beijing (Xinhua: [“全球视野下中国文化的融合与贡献”主题沙龙在京举办](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPSDJHWWs2NU9IMHlRRXNHb181UE1xYW1xUV9nZkttQS1zNjdXYTRnV1V4Q3dVRW9PSWpyZE9PRW1JaGczRmZWeXp1RW9DT3Y2aW9hX1NlLThoVHg2MGRNSDJXTUFtdjVseTdGczk1RnFldnFhMTcwQjhkRmNwd1lIc0FhX1Vvdw)).
- **China sends medical team to DRC for Ebola**: A Chinese anti-epidemic medical expert team arrived in the DRC to support Ebola control (People's Daily via Google News: [中国抗疫医疗专家组抵达刚果（金）](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1WT3FfVkhnaWlMXzdWY3NFLU5uTjhDVUR5VE51YlBzRGRqaHEzdGtlaEFiYTNWT2w3SldRd2h0Y1ZSM0dhNzg0Unlva3dWalVOM0JGUGlfMEExSDdEbFAwcDRuXzZTSDJ3c0trdw)).
- **Sanxingdui discoveries**: Red carnelian artifacts from Sanxingdui reveal Bronze Age exchange networks (Xinhua: [三星堆出土红玉髓：揭示中国青铜时代交流互动](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOdEhBSVBUMmpIM1JhdVY0TktjelB6MzkzVzhWUW1CNGhGRDdhUktJb25EanVzY3NmM05aTmVxSnZwRlhueW9zaFdzSkhtLTRFSmhja2Y5dHAxcldDclo3VW5fZkUtQkVOT3hxSS1PQ2h3VzZ6ZXM2TFdjTnpUXy1id0JsNnlsOXc)).

**Signal to watch:** China's AI integration in education may accelerate skill development but also raise surveillance concerns. The Ebola medical mission reinforces China's soft power in Africa.

知乎社区动态.zh:
中文互联网社区正经历情怀与商业的残酷对决：曾经的中文论坛象征天涯社区在尝试重启时，被投资人痛批“不如留点养老钱”，而小红书与知乎的狂奔则印证了“情怀不能当饭吃”。两条动态共同指向一个趋势——用户社区已从理想主义转向实用主义，商业变现能力成为生存核心。

- 天涯重启遇冷：有投资人直言“别重启了，给投资人留点养老钱”，暗示其商业模式与流量价值已不匹配（[澎湃](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5OTE5HeEJkaHhuV1YzV3pOOWxmOVBHOGhqOFZfSzVnc21jZTJZMVZQcno5dG5aVU1Qd0t2Y3ZDR1R5eXRLZV9xcDZFNzlaS01kX21HSVNJSklDdldpdW5jdg)）。
- 平台分化：分析文章指出，中文社区“不相信情怀”，小红书和知乎的高速发展才是现实逻辑（[维科号](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE53b0ZsYlFWLXlUX1FQakRRRlBGNFRuZktiQUVuVkpNamJ0dkpJc2tLRzU3QmJaUGdwMmRrZmdDQkRnNE90TFluSFUxS1dsS0d6TzZFS3Vibw)）。

收束：天涯的困境折射出老一代互联网社区的集体焦虑——在短视频与算法推荐主导的今天，单纯依靠用户情怀已无法支撑运营，社区产品的迭代方向必须直面商业化的冷酷考验。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu community dynamics this cycle are focused on the potential revival of the once-popular Tianya forum and the contrasting trajectories of Chinese social platforms. Two articles discuss whether Tianya should be restarted or if it's better to let it fade, and the broader theme that Chinese communities now prioritize growth over nostalgia.

- **Tianya revival debate**: An article argues against reviving Tianya, suggesting it would waste investors' money (thepaper.cn: [天涯还是别重启了，给投资人留点养老钱吧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5OTE5HeEJkaHhuV1YzV3pOOWxmOVBHOGhqOFZfSzVnc21jZTJZMVZQcno5dG5aVU1Qd0t2Y3ZDR1R5eXRLZV9xcDZFNzlaS01kX21HSVNJSklDdldpdW5jdg)).
- **Platform competition**: A piece compares Tianya's attempted comeback with Zhihu and Xiaohongshu's rapid growth, concluding that sentimentality won't sustain a platform (维科号: [天涯回归、小红书知乎狂奔：中文社区不相信情怀](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE53b0ZsYlFWLXlUX1FQakRRRlBGNFRuZktiQUVuVkpNamJ0dkpJc2tLRzU3QmJaUGdwMmRrZmdDQkRnNE90TFluSFUxS1dsS0d6TzZFS3Vibw)).

**Signal to watch:** The Zhihu community's skepticism about reviving old platforms suggests a shift toward pragmatism. Users may increasingly favor platforms that offer utility and fresh content over nostalgia. Watch for any official announcement from Tianya's management.

国际安全.zh:
**概览**：美伊直接军事冲突在24小时内急剧升温，伊朗首次对科威特和巴林发动攻击，美军则对伊朗本土附近军事设施实施打击。双方均使用导弹、无人机和海军力量，红海与霍尔木兹海峡成为高风险区域。

- **伊朗攻击科威特与巴林**：伊朗革命卫队宣称发动了导弹、无人机和海上打击。科威特称机场遭伊朗无人机袭击，巴林同样受攻击。[Iran Launches New Attacks On Kuwait, Bahrain](https://www.twz.com/news-features/iran-launches-new-attacks-on-kuwait-bahrain)
- **美军拦截并反击**：美国中央司令部在格什姆岛打击伊朗地面控制站，发射“地狱火”导弹攻击油轮，并拦截了多枚伊朗导弹。[US Says It Fired Hellfire Missile at Oil Tanker](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNTjFvV25FNHgyQl9IOE14UjBGcW9PaGlRYXotYW4yZEJtRUVNcEN2R2d6SloyWGtOeVJTdmRxTDNJS1JmaVNtZ1pvcHpONGhiTVFuNjV4cXhZeUJITmNLOXNzdFBYM1FhTl91OUZ5WHhLc2hINnNLN3pTLWZfalhFNTBsczViSXZYNmhja3dNTnVJOXBBcF85bU0wN283aGM)
- **“自卫”与“停火”的悖论**：CBS新闻指出，美军在击落伊朗导弹后继续“自卫打击”，停火协议名存实亡。[U.S. conducts more self-defense strikes after shooting down Iranian missiles](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPd0NDZ0NpMnRwbkZnOHVzM0czVTdnY3lGQ2swNmhoaUEwbjFsYnlaZHZ4NmZoMDFqMXRiWVI2VDItUGMxanZhSzBEZ2RhZl84aTlrbng0WF9CQkZqMVRJWmM2TVNER1IweV9yNTFXNlpoUU90RlR1clJBaDA2Vk5ET2ltcG5lUFZDRDQ0bg)
- **法国限制以色列参加防务展**：欧洲最大防务展Eurosatory因以色列在黎巴嫩军事行动导致法以关系紧张，以色列企业参展受限。[France restricts Israeli presence at Europe’s biggest defense show](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/06/02/france-restricts-israeli-presence-at-europes-biggest-defense-show)

**判断**：美伊冲突已从海上拦截升级为对海湾国家本土的攻击，战争规模扩大的风险极高。能源市场反应剧烈，投资者已开始押注石油供应中断。
国际安全.en:
The US-Iran military confrontation has escalated sharply, with both sides conducting direct strikes for the first time since the collapse of the ceasefire. US Central Command conducted self-defense strikes on an Iranian ground control station on Qeshm Island and fired a Hellfire missile at an oil tanker, while Iran launched missile and drone attacks targeting Kuwait, Bahrain, and a commercial vessel in the Gulf. US forces intercepted multiple projectiles but the situation remains highly volatile. This represents a significant departure from previous proxy engagements and raises the risk of a wider regional war.

- **US strikes on Qeshm Island and Iranian retaliation:** CENTCOM confirmed strikes on an Iranian military facility, prompting Iran to retaliate with attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain. [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/iran-launches-new-attacks-on-kuwait-bahrain) and [Newsweek](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNTjFvV25FNHgyQl9IOE14UjBGcW9PaGlRYXotYW4yZEJtRUVNcEN2R2d6SloyWGtOeVJTdmRxTDNJS1JmaVNtZ1pvcHpONGhiTVFuNjV4cXhZeUJITmNLOXNzdFBYM1FhTl91OUZ5WHhLc2hINnNLN3pTLWZfalhFNTBsczViSXZYNmhja3dNTnVJOXBBcF85bU0wN283aGM)

- **Interceptions and continued self-defense strikes:** U.S. forces shot down Iranian missiles and drones, then conducted additional self-defense strikes, testing the fragile ceasefire. [CBS News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPd0NDZ0NpMnRwbkZnOHVzM0czVTdnY3lGQ2swNmhoaUEwbjFsYnlaZHZ4NmZoMDFqMXRiWVI2VDItUGMxanZhSzBEZ2RhZl84aTlrbng0WF9CQkZqMVRJWmM2TVNER1IweV9yNTFXNlpoUU90RlR1clJBaDA2Vk5ET2ltcG5lUFZDRDQ0bg) and [Stars and Stripes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPbjFGRWZIaG9zN1ZvazVNbnZtcjJvNFVPamVCd1JSOTNqNjEwaXpxVk5MRVI5UTVVTDFQMVJBdnZzSVhxdG1vaFY2ak1URXd2VzZFTlVzMWxOT21jV1NOemNBdmxFcXFyUU9tdVJrWEd4VWM1TnI4QTk2RjY2cTN6ci1KS3F6RnRPYWpXS0JRODd2WE83RUdYOTFxTXFVaVNKam1POEJ2QlMwSFE)

- **Russia’s use of Zircon hypersonic missiles in Ukraine:** In parallel, Russia employed Zircon anti-ship missiles against Ukrainian cities, straining Ukrainian air defenses. [Defence Industry Europe](https://news.google.)

- **US special operations surveillance plane replacement abandoned:** The U.S. special operations community appears to be ending dedicated crewed surveillance planes, signaling a shift in ISR posture. [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/any-plans-for-direct-u-28-draco-special-ops-surveillance-plane-replacement-abandoned)

**Signal to watch:** The durability of any mutual de-escalation or ceasefire remains in doubt. The next 24–48 hours will determine whether this becomes a sustained conflict or a controlled spike.

冲突局势.zh:
**概览**：中东大战阴影下，能源安全与航运线路成为焦点。霍尔木兹海峡受阻的替代路线讨论升温，伊朗进一步威胁红海封锁，全球贸易格局面临重塑压力。俄乌战线则出现精英阶层呼吁停战的声音。

- **航运业紧急调整**：Posidonia 2026会议上，航运领袖指出地缘政治正在重新定义市场和贸易流，船东被敦促保持灵活性。[Shipping Leaders at Posidonia 2026: Geopolitics Now Redefines Markets and Trade Flows](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPWWthc2ltNF9pdE1qYXFDaDdiSUl3X29EQWVQOWJqUVpBNGNGUjQ0MHRMQUVkamtoWG80T25HRDlBNEFVbHdLWUs2QXMxbEhnNFdmdk1BemFWejRSanBuMUYxLUVFMF9KNGl5RjRzbUFtQUVleFpsZUpaN3FuaGVCRnd4V1UzSG1SMHlSZWFMLWJBZHA5Vnc)
- **替代油气路线受关注**：若霍尔木兹海峡长期中断，中东油气出口需经陆路或绕行其他航线，EnergyNow分析了潜在替代方案。[Alternative Routes for Middle East Oil and Gas Due to Hormuz Disruption](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNNE1fMzFiSjhrOFpJV21kajdMYkJEd20zcGM4Sm0yREpWU09IZnBwX0VyUk9LTWlHYWhDYXZCOS04eng0d1lPdVlKX2pZUjFwYzAwZkM4NWlDazVaSUFfRHlLaTczenpiZTdrb0lXd09XZTRiWHpNVGYxcDRjaHhoZ3JvcVFtb1VZM29raVc4RE9kUXBZWVdkbmktRU5FbV9hb1Fweg)
- **伊朗威胁红海封锁**：Kurdistan24报道，在停火谈判受阻、地区紧张加剧的背景下，伊朗扬言封锁红海。[Iran Threatens Red Sea Blockade as Ceasefire Talks Falter](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxQQ0FSNkhBZWxlYVNZYm00YzRmUEQySzhqZV9OeEZ1UFk3ZjRvYUVONURWWjQ1bWJ3OWdmTHplX0ZxVVNlaDFxaEtwMmwxOGMwR1B3VWhTSVM3cVpRYU00LWhLSTJXWDNJUW4wSHpZXzFiVUZsNVc1UkpZYTdjd2V5bkJFTlptLUxVS2cxRXd3YWpCVDBlRUZkdzNIMDZrZUpkYXBnZzgtZk5ZQ3RFUWJUVFBXamE1SlFjUWZWaElLVDJkX25DMHhLbg)
- **俄乌战场新动向**：俄罗斯精英因经济疲软正推动结束乌克兰战争，同时基辅方面，前总统波罗申科就停火条件发表强硬表态。[Russian elites push to end Ukraine war as economy falters](https://news.google.)

**判断**：中东冲突已从军事领域外溢至全球能源与航运，霍尔木兹海峡和红海的双重威胁将推高保险和运费，全球经济复苏面临新压力。
冲突局势.en:
The US-Iran confrontation is reshaping energy security and global shipping routes, with the Strait of Hormuz at the center of the crisis. Investors are turning to energy stocks like Shell as a hedge, while shipping leaders at Posidonia 2026 highlight how geopolitics is redefining trade flows. Iran’s threat of a Red Sea blockade adds another layer of risk to already disrupted supply chains.

- **Energy security focus amid Middle East conflict:** Investors are tipping Shell as a beneficiary of the crisis, with focus on energy security. [Energy Voice](https://news.google.)

- **Shipping markets and trade flows disrupted:** At Posidonia 2026, shipping leaders noted that geopolitics is now the primary driver of market changes, with shipowners urged to adapt. [IndexBox](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPWWthc2ltNF9pdE1qYXFDaDdiSUl3X29EQWVQOWJqUVpBNGNGUjQ0MHRMQUVkamtoWG80T25HRDlBNEFVbHdLWUs2QXMxbEhnNFdmdk1BemFWejRSanBuMUYxLUVFMF9KNGl5RjRzbUFtQUVleFpsZUpaN3FuaGVCRnd4V1UzSG1SMHlSZWFMLWJBZHA5Vnc) and [Splash247](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxOWjhoQ2xfbXdNTUZGVUtXVTdKVWJ0OWd4UkpEOFNvVzhFbFFrckV0X0ttNHRHQVhjMjlZSlpIemgtUFZUZVJaTjAxNmNVdHNlT2c5M0VaMzNSUjlHMExYZ3Vjendid0NHRXNWUndDaTVkQ1F3dGtDWmlMLTJMZHF4RGl2b1hNZmZxU2tVS1ZUOXJ5MVAta0lYTG5R)

- **Alternative routes for oil and gas amid Hormuz disruption:** Analysts are mapping alternative routes for Middle East oil and gas due to the Strait of Hormuz disruption. [EnergyNow.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNNE1fMzFiSjhrOFpJV21kajdMYkJEd20zcGM4Sm0yREpWU09IZnBwX0VyUk9LTWlHYWhDYXZCOS04eng0d1lPdVlKX2pZUjFwYzAwZkM4NWlDazVaSUFfRHlLaTczenpiZTdrb0lXd09XZTRiWHpNVGYxcDRjaHhoZ3JvcVFtb1VZM29raVc4RE9kUXBZWVdkbmktRU5FbV9hb1Fweg)

- **Iran threatens Red Sea blockade; ceasefire talks falter:** Iran has threatened to block the Red Sea as ceasefire negotiations with the US stall. [Kurdistan24](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxQQ0FSNkhBZWxlYVNZYm00YzRmUEQySzhqZV9OeEZ1UFk3ZjRvYUVONURWWjQ1bWJ3OWdmTHplX0ZxVVNlaDFxaEtwMmwxOGMwR1B3VWhTSVM3cVpRYU00LWhLSTJXWDNJUW4wSHpZXzFiVUZsNVc1UkpZYTdjd2V5bkJFTlptLUxVS2cxRXd3YWpCVDBlRUZkdzNIMDZrZUpkYXBnZzgtZk5ZQ3RFUWJUVFBXamE1SlFjUWZWaElLVDJkX25DMHhLbg)

- **US ally responds to Trump’s call on Strait of Hormuz:** A US ally answered Trump’s call regarding the Strait of Hormuz, characterizing it as part of a diplomatic effort. [WFIN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxPcFdOb0pfRkhnUlg5SU9xejluMV81czJEWHVYS1FmVm9WR1RucmZyQkpydmRiZ3FsLXhSNkFWaFN2SDRXNmFUWVlfakhQWnFDaWxKRTRhRkpwZkV2SWxwZUhDT2lMbTg5NkpNaXY2ZzNRYU9qd2hidVo2N2p1OHd6YzAyWWdtVFl4a0x6Qko1Q29TZTZ1LTc4YkNjV2xaeU9VOXNrd3Ixd2dMR0VR)

**Signal to watch:** The ability of global shipping to reroute and the willingness of strategic petroleum reserves to be tapped will be key indicators of market stability in the coming weeks.

中国军情.zh:
**概览**：台海与南海方向，日本防卫相鼓吹“再军事化”并推销护卫舰，菲律宾防长南海言论遭中方批驳。中国大陆通过舆论与实际行动双线回应，包括国台办驳斥澳报告、军演与油气平台展示能力。

- **国台办驳斥澳报告台海恐慌论**：澳大利亚所谓报告渲染台海危机，国台办回应称“不得人心”，重申和平统一方针。[澳报告兜售台海危机恐慌 国台办：不得人心](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBqcVRRQjZOU0pQMmV4QkxkeWgtU0Jwdk5rRFJ2NWVkSmlGZ3lxbkFEb3ZpMHRFeFdRblVWd0RXdlJpaEJ6ZTBGNGRFazJfZVNKRmg1TWk1TkR0N1pYaDZxcHEyQ0RUbTltczRIZw)
- **日本防卫相推“再军事化”**：日本防卫大臣在公开场合鼓吹日本安全新角色，并推销新型护卫舰，外界解读为军事扩张信号。[“推销”护卫舰鼓吹“新角色” 日防卫相为日本“再军事化”摇旗呐喊](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE9OWXEzQkFzakZ5SXJhcFNVN0xiSDhOUm9vdzU5M1V2MXdtUjEzRVN4VUdFcnd4OEd2SXZuV0F1QkNrS3FhMEtzUnBEQVo5cU8xQTY5QlBoYXFQOE5KLWI5WTQ0N3JUTFFKdmpkWjZ0S2pWUTYtRXc)
- **日菲联合划界传闻**：网络消息称日本与菲律宾在相关海域联合划定边界，中国顺势强化台海全域管控。消息尚未获官方确认，但引发舆论热议。[乐子大了！日菲联合划界，中国顺势管控台海全域](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9ja3hrOHczQXIta1ZoMDZXeWpXLVJENk92emwzMkJlcDN5RkV0RzhGb2o1VlQ2RlB2ZTBGZUhlSGdHTWFpb2l3cS15UWpSNG5EY3RCUkZQZUZ5dTZpdnBRbmNTQjFkeWs2ZTRvV3VfWTRtcE5G)
- **赖清德与卢比奥表态**：赖清德称维持台海和平现状，卢比奥表态希望“维持此刻现状”，美国之音报道双方立场微妙。[赖清德：将致力维持台海和平现状；卢比奥：希望台海维持此刻现状](https://news.google.)
- **中国军方被曝长期设法获取英伟达芯片**：RFI报道中国军方及“国防七子”高校机构长期通过隐秘渠道获取英伟达高端芯片，暴露技术管控漏洞。[中国军方及“国防七子”机构长期设法获得英伟达芯片受关注](https://news.google.)

**判断**：围绕台海与南海的博弈进入高频交锋期，日本动作频繁、美方表态模糊，大陆则通过军事演习和法律工具稳固立场。芯片管制问题揭示“军-民-学”链条的潜在风险，或引发美方更严措施。
中国军情.en:
China’s military posture remains active on multiple fronts. The PLA Navy’s Liaoning carrier strike group conducted 170 sorties in the Philippine Sea, showcasing operational reach. Meanwhile, Beijing is pushing back against Australian warnings of a Taiwan Strait crisis and defending its South China Sea positions. The acquisition of advanced US chips by Chinese military-linked entities continues to draw scrutiny.

- **PLAN carrier sorties in Philippine Sea:** The Liaoning CSG conducted 80 sorties on May 26, 50 on May 27, and 40 on May 28, tracked by Japan’s JMSDF. This demonstrates sustained carrier operations capability. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/02/chinese-carrier-strike-group-conducts-170-sorties-during-drills-in-philippine-sea)

- **Taiwan Strait tensions: Australia report and official responses:** An Australian report warning of a Taiwan Strait crisis was dismissed by China’s Taiwan Affairs Office as “unpopular.” Taiwan’s President Lai pledged to maintain peace, and US Secretary Rubio expressed desire for status quo. [China Review](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBqcVRRQjZOU0pQMmV4QkxkeWgtU0Jwdk5rRFJ2NWVkSmlGZ3lxbkFEb3ZpMHRFeFdRblVWd0RXdlJpaEJ6ZTBGNGRFazJfZVNKRmg1TWk1TkR0N1pYaDZxcHEyQ0RUbTltczRIZw), [Voice of America](https://news.google.)

- **South China Sea disputes: China rebuts Philippine defense minister’s claims:** A China News commentary refuted the Philippine defense minister’s statements on the South China Sea, calling them “fourfold flaws.” [China Net](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE9waTBITWNLRjNFTmVnNEVmTUhIbVRGeE43X0VDel9kQ0JIUHdUWGdvS2k2VHdwZUhzNF9Nc2lmUVBJeVZ6d2JFM3R2UjJiZ3BOM09sa0lyTGRLU3RqN1dCYzV2X2RxamludmlrR1BTcjdzdk0)

- **China’s military-linked entities seek Nvidia chips:** RFI reports that Chinese military institutions and the “Defense Seven Sons” have long sought to acquire Nvidia chips despite export controls. [RFI](https://news.google.)

- **Japan’s defense minister promotes frigate sales and new role for JSDF:** Japan’s defense minister is actively marketing frigates and advocating for a “new role” for the Self-Defense Forces, signaling further militarization. [China News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE9OWXEzQkFzakZ5SXJhcFNVN0xiSDhOUm9vdzU5M1V2MXdtUjEzRVN4VUdFcnd4OEd2SXZuV0F1QkNrS3FhMEtzUnBEQVo5cU8xQTY5QlBoYXFQOE5KLWI5WTQ0N3JUTFFKdmpkWjZ0S2pWUTYtRXc)

**Signal to watch:** Continued PLAN carrier operations and any new incidents in the Taiwan Strait or South China Sea will be key. The chip acquisition story may drive new US export control actions.

海军与印太.zh:
**概览**：印太海军动态活跃，辽宁舰航母打击群在菲律宾海完成高强度训练，新西兰海军启动二十年舰队更新计划，土耳其举行大规模两栖演习，美海军无人舰项目进入海试阶段。

- **辽宁舰170架次起降**：5月26日至6月1日，辽宁舰航母打击群在菲律宾海（吕宋以东）进行训练，完成80、50、40架次起降，日本“五月雨”号驱逐舰持续监视。[Chinese Carrier Strike Group Conducts 170 Sorties During Drills in Philippine Sea](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/02/chinese-carrier-strike-group-conducts-170-sorties-during-drills-in-philippine-sea)
- **新西兰海军公布舰队更新优先项**：在CNE 2026会议上，新西兰皇家海军提出二十年计划，涵盖结构、训练、基础设施与保障体系重塑，被视为“一次性的转型机遇”。[RNZN outlines fleet renewal priorities at CNE 2026](https://www.navalnews.com/event-news/cne-2026/2026/06/rnzn-outlines-fleet-renewal-priorities-at-cne-2026/)
- **土耳其“安卡拉野心”两栖演习**：土爱琴海陆军使用2000磅炸弹、舰炮和炮兵进行联合火力展示，彰显安卡拉在该区域的军事投射能力。[Ankara’s Ambition](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/02/ankaras-ambition)
- **HII公司ROMULUS无人艇进入海试**：中型无人水面艇开始海上测试，美海军推进无人化舰队构想，HII表示将进入后续测试阶段。[HII’s ROMULUS USV Advances to U.S. Navy Medium USV At-Sea Testing Phase](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hiis-romulus-usv-advances-to-u-s-navy-medium-usv-at-sea-testing-phase/)
- **罗马尼亚订购德制巡逻艇**：罗马尼亚国防部与莱茵金属签约，采购近海巡逻艇和潜水支援艇，加强黑海方向海防能力。[Romania: Rheinmetall contracted to supply OPVs and diver support boats](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/romania-rheinmetall-contracted-to-supply-opvs-and-diver-support-boats/)

**判断**：印太地区航母活动常态化，辽宁舰高强度起降说明中国海军远海空战能力已具备实战水平。同时，中小国家海军更新换代与北约东翼海军增强并行，全球海军装备市场进入活跃期。
海军与印太.en:
Naval developments in the Indo-Pacific and beyond reflect strategic fleet modernizations and power projection. The Chinese Liaoning carrier group’s high sortie rate in the Philippine Sea is the standout event, but RNZN fleet renewal plans, Turkish live-fire exercises, HII’s USV testing, and Romanian OPV procurement also signal shifting naval priorities.

- **Chinese Carrier Strike Group conducts 170 sorties in Philippine Sea:** The PLAN Liaoning CSG operated east of Luzon with 80, 50, and 40 sorties on consecutive days, tracked by Japanese destroyer. This demonstrates sustained carrier air power capability and reach. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/02/chinese-carrier-strike-group-conducts-170-sorties-during-drills-in-philippine-sea)

- **Royal New Zealand Navy outlines fleet renewal priorities:** RNZN is progressing a long-term fleet renewal program that will reshape force structure over two decades, as outlined by Commodore Brendon Clark at CNE 2026. [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/event-news/cne-2026/2026/06/rnzn-outlines-fleet-renewal-priorities-at-cne-2026/)

- **Turkey’s Aegean Army conducts major live-fire drills:** Ankara’s ambition was on display with two-thousand-pound bombs, artillery, and naval bombardments during exercises near Doganbey, signaling continued regional assertiveness. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/02/ankaras-ambition)

- **HII’s ROMULUS USV advances to Navy’s at-sea testing:** Huntington Ingalls Industries’ ROMULUS medium unmanned surface vessel started sea trials, moving toward Navy’s Medium USV program. [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hiis-romulus-usv-advances-to-u-s-navy-medium-usv-at-sea-testing-phase/)

- **Romania contracts Rheinmetall for OPVs and diver support boats:** The Romanian Ministry of Defence signed a contract with Rheinmetall for offshore patrol vessels and diving support boats. [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/romania-rheinmetall-contracted-to-supply-opvs-and-diver-support-boats/)

**Signal to watch:** The PLAN’s sustained carrier operations in the Philippine Sea may foreshadow routine deployments. The progress of USV testing will be a key metric for the Navy’s unmanned vision.

汽车.zh:
电动汽车市场出现结构分化：高端个性化车型依赖海外需求，商用重卡和大众市场SUV则在国内加速渗透，技术路线和政策博弈成为关键变量。

- [Cybertruck获哈萨克斯坦紧急服务订单](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/tesla-cybertruck-kazakhstan-emergency-services/) —— 国内需求疲软下，中亚市场为这款争议车型提供新出路，但规模有限。
- [Orange EV创纪录600辆电动重卡订单](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/orange-ev-scores-record-600-unit-order-as-demand-for-electric-semi-trucks-soars/) —— 无联邦激励仍获大单，证明物流行业电气化已具备经济性，二阶影响将带动充电基建需求。
- [BYD铝合金框架减重超百磅](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/byd-says-its-cast-aluminum-frame-is-lighter-tougher-and-safer-than-steel/) —— 仰望U8L的技术突破可能重塑大型SUV安全与能效标准，对竞品形成压力。
- [纽约州起诉内政部10亿美元贿赂案](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/new-york-sues-over-interior-dept-s-1b-bribe-to-an-oil-company-stop-wind-power/) —— 联邦政府用纳税人钱扼杀清洁能源项目，法律挑战或影响后续海上风电审批。
- [Subaru新EV两月超越Solterra](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/subarus-new-evs-already-outselling-solterra/) —— 产品力差异直接反映在销量上，为传统车企电动化转型提供警示。

总体而言，电动汽车市场正从“政策驱动”转向“产品/场景驱动”，但地缘政治和政策干预仍是不可忽视的变量。
汽车.en:
The EV sector shows robust commercial adoption and international expansion. Heavy-duty electric trucks see record orders, while passenger EVs push material innovation and new markets.

- **Kazakhstan** emergency services confirm additional Cybertruck purchases after successful rescue deployments in Almaty. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/tesla-cybertruck-kazakhstan-emergency-services/)
- **Orange EV** lands a record 600-unit order for electric Class 8 terminal trucks, proving market demand even without federal subsidies. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/orange-ev-scores-record-600-unit-order-as-demand-for-electric-semi-trucks-soars/)
- **BYD** introduces a cast aluminum frame for its Yangwang U8L that is lighter and stronger than steel, passing extreme lift tests. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/byd-says-its-cast-aluminum-frame-is-lighter-tougher-and-safer-than-steel/)
- **Dodge** opens orders for the 2027 Charger Daytona EV with 670 hp and a NACS port, but pricing remains high. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/2027-dodge-charger-ev-adds-nacs-not-cheap/)
- **Subaru's** new electric SUVs quickly outsell the Solterra, suggesting better market fit. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/06/02/subarus-new-evs-already-outselling-solterra/)
**Closing signal:** The shift toward heavy-duty electrification and material innovation suggests long-term EV integration beyond passenger cars, with international buyers cushioning some domestic demand dips.

科技产品.zh:
消费电子领域呈现“大作与禁令并存”的态势：索尼以《战神》新作巩固主机生态，而波兰等国家则加速限制智能设备进入校园。无人驾驶服务的社会学细节开始浮现，Meta的内部监控政策引发争议。

- [《战神：劳菲》PS5独占公布](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/941516/god-of-war-laufey-ps5-trailer) —— 延续北欧神话线，未公布发售日，但作为State of Play压轴，显示索尼对第一方IP的持续投入。
- [波兰拟禁止学校使用手机和智能手表](https://www.engadget.com/2186323/poland-classroom-phone-ban-online-porn-age-check-bills/) —— 继法国、芬兰后，欧洲教育科技市场面临政策冲击，相关硬件及管理软件厂商需调整策略。
- [Uber公开数千件无人车遗留物](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/squishmallows-dentures-and-an-i-heart-hot-dads-bag-uber-has-found-thousands-of-items-left-in-robotaxis/) —— 从玩偶到假牙，数据侧面验证无人驾驶出租车已深入日常，但遗留物品处理效率影响用户体验。
- [Meta允许员工30分钟脱离追踪](https://www.engadget.com/2186261/meta-will-reportedly-let-employees-take-30-minute-breaks-from-its-tracking-program/) —— “监控资本主义”反噬内部管理，其他科技公司可能面临类似压力。

当前科技产品正从“追求功能”转向“权衡社会影响”，隐私、监管和伦理议题正在重塑产品定义。
科技产品.en:
Consumer tech news is dominated by a major gaming reveal, a national phone ban, and workplace privacy adjustments. Coupon deals fill the feed but the actionable shifts are in policy and product.

- **Sony** announces *God of War Laufey* for PS5, the next chapter in the franchise, with no release date yet. [Source](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/941516/god-of-war-laufey-ps5-trailer)
- **Poland** moves to ban phones and smartwatches in schools, a significant digital regulation that could influence other nations. [Source](https://www.engadget.com/2186323/poland-classroom-phone-ban-online-porn-age-check-bills/)
- **Meta** will reportedly allow employees 30-minute breaks from its workplace tracking program, reflecting growing privacy concerns. [Source](https://www.engadget.com/2186261/meta-will-reportedly-let-employees-take-30-minute-breaks-from-its-tracking-program/)
- **Uber** reveals thousands of bizarre lost items from robotaxis, including dentures and a 'Hot Dads' bag, highlighting operational quirks. [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/squishmallows-dentures-and-an-i-heart-hot-dads-bag-uber-has-found-thousands-of-items-left-in-robotaxis/)
- **UE Wonderboom 4** hits a new low price of $51.49 on Amazon, a notable deal for floatable Bluetooth speakers. [Source](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/941763/ultimate-ears-wonderboom-fractal-design-scape-deal-sale)
**Closing signal:** Consumer tech is increasingly intersecting with regulation and workplace ethics, as seen in Poland's phone ban and Meta's tracking concessions.

AI.zh:
AI行业在微软Build 2026的催化下加速扩张，但同时面临监管内部分歧、内容版权冲突以及技术范式转移的临界点。

- [微软Build 2026七大公告](https://www.theverge.com/tech/941738/microsoft-build-2026-biggest-announcements) —— 全天候个人助理和新Surface标志微软从“AI工具”转向“AI生活入口”，对谷歌和苹果形成直接压力。
- [特朗普政府AI监管路线内讧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNREtSUDhhcVBDX3hpa3ZKbDg4VzRrMzNVSk1XaTNCcjltVUpFaDZZN0EtTFZFSjI3SXJGVEVGREJDb3Jtb184aThoMXVFNEtGSHZyWXFfUmRrZ0tDWnVqZmFab0VIVzVJVWFndkQ1UHo2TFdjcUNqUFB3cGVUakZZTjJRYWpFTGlfNjVIVU5RSVVLd3AxSGpUM3c5OWpEWW8) —— 行政分支内部对立可能拖延联邦AI法案，各州自行立法风险上升。
- [Google允许网站退出AI搜索结果](https://www.engadget.com/2186257/google-will-allow-websites-to-exclude-themselves-from-ai-search-results/) —— 英国媒体率先获准，此举或缓解内容生态紧张，但可能削弱AI搜索的竞争力，形成“有摘要无内容”的悖论。
- [AI教父们涌入创业圈](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE12dWQweVVQQ1VUNmhqUFJmSE82UnI3NWlCRGV3M0IxVG9ZSGJtYmQtMV96Uy0wektubUY2SGVKalFwR29aNzFnSHBrUFpHUjFteE9R) —— Yoshua Bengio等顶尖学者转向创业，预示着下一代AI范式（如世界模型、因果推理）可能迅速商业化。
- [小企业AI应用指南发布](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/06/02/1138227/how-small-businesses-can-leverage-ai/) —— MIT Tech Review的实操指南降低门槛，但需警惕“范围跃迁”导致的开发失控（如[HN热帖](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48380952)所述）。

AI正从“技术试验”步入“社会融合”关键期，规则制定与技术创新之间的张力将决定未来走向。
AI.en:
AI governance and enterprise adoption dominate headlines, with major moves by Google and Microsoft, plus internal political conflict in Washington. Publishers gain new leverage, and a new startup from an AI pioneer emerges.

- **Google** allows all websites to opt out of AI search summaries, following a UK media deal that gives publishers control over content use in AI. [Source: Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/03/uk-media-groups-power-opt-out-google-ai-search-summaries) and [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2186257/google-will-allow-websites-to-exclude-themselves-from-ai-search-results/)
- **Microsoft Build 2026** announces an always-on AI assistant, new Surface devices, and major updates to its AI models. [Source](https://www.theverge.com/tech/941738/microsoft-build-2026-biggest-announcements)
- **Trump administration** is reportedly at war with itself over AI regulation, per Tech Buzz, indicating policy paralysis. [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNREtSUDhhcVBDX3hpa3ZKbDg4VzRrMzNVSk1XaTNCcjltVUpFaDZZN0EtTFZFSjI3SXJGVEVGREJDb3Jtb184aThoMXVFNEtGSHZyWXFfUmRrZ0tDWnVqZmFab0VIVzVJVWFndkQ1UHo2TFdjcUNqUFB3cGVUakZZTjJRYWpFTGlfNjVIVU5RSVVLd3AxSGpUM3c5OWpEWW8)
- **MIT Technology Review** reports how small businesses can leverage AI for accounting, design, and research. [Source](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/06/02/1138227/how-small-businesses-can-leverage-ai/)
- **'Godfather of AI'** enters the startup scene as Silicon Valley bets on a next-generation AI paradigm, per 36Kr. [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE12dWQweVVQQ1VUNmhqUFJmSE82UnI3NWlCRGV3M0IxVG9ZSGJtYmQtMV96Uy0wektubUY2SGVKalFwR29aNzFnSHBrUFpHUjFteE9R)
**Closing signal:** The battle over AI content usage and regulation is intensifying, with publishers and governments pushing back against tech giants, while enterprise adoption accelerates and new AI paradigms emerge.

足球.zh: 足坛昨夜今晨掀起转会与规则双重震荡。曼联已与亚特兰大就巴西中场埃德森达成3500万英镑协议，他即将成为卡里克上任后的首签，填补中场硬度缺失的关键拼图。利物浦在解雇斯洛特后迅速行动，与伯恩茅斯主帅伊劳拉达成口头协议，后者以高位逼抢和灵活变阵著称，将承担复兴重任。国际足联宣布2026世界杯启用新型越位技术，通过自动传感取消延迟举旗，这意味着边裁不再需要等待进攻完成再判定，进攻方将获得更多节奏优势。此外，亚马尔以16球11助成为本世纪西甲唯一进球助攻均上双的U20球员，巴萨未来核心地位更加稳固。威尔士主帅贝拉米明确表示科马斯未来将移师中锋位置，锐化攻击线。本日最值得关注的是利物浦换帅后的战术方向与曼联新援能否迅速融入。
足球.en:
The football desk was flooded with high-impact news despite many non-football items being mis-attributed here. Two managerial moves dominated: Liverpool's verbal agreement with Andoni Iraola to replace the sacked Arne Slot, and Manchester United's £35m deal for Atalanta midfielder Ederson, Michael Carrick's first signing. The World Cup also featured—FIFA announced a new semi-automated offside technology that will eliminate the delayed flag at the 2026 tournament. Other notable stories: Wales boss Craig Bellamy sees Lewis Koumas as a future centre-forward, and a look at Golden Boot contenders for the 2026 World Cup. Meanwhile, the Messi vs Ronaldo rivalry documentary trailer dropped. Several non-football items appeared under this desk: Charles Leclerc's Ferrari extension, Marta Kostyuk's French Open win, Heather Knight's England cricket form, and Rory McIlroy's Masters advice from Jack Nicklaus. Readers should note the RSS categorization seems broad, but the core football news is significant.

- [Liverpool agree deal with Iraola to succeed Slot](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4gv1ydm4yro)
- [Man Utd agree £35m fee for Atalanta's Ederson](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c78q2dxv89go)
- [No more delayed flag? Fifa adds new offside tech for World Cup](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c232d34kkyzo)
- [Bellamy sees Koumas future at centre-forward](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c1724lqy2jgo)
- [The anatomy of a Golden Boot winner - and who could win it in 2026?](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/ce3pe9nxe7jo)

Expect more transfer dominoes as the summer window approaches; Liverpool's Iraola appointment could trigger a chain reaction in Premier League tactics.

羽毛球.zh: 印尼羽毛球公开赛第二日全面展开，国羽多线出击。男双陈柏阳/刘毅迎战东道主强档阿尔菲安/菲克里，首局虽0-1落后但仍有逆转空间；女单王祉怡对阵新加坡杨佳敏，历史交手6-0占据绝对优势。女双贾一凡/张殊贤组合开赛，新搭档的默契度值得观察。此外，男双黄荻/刘阳将面对加拿大组合凯文·李/林德曼，赛程紧凑。王昶在首轮失利后总结经验，国羽年轻选手的调整能力将成为后续关键。整体来看，国羽在印尼公开赛面临主场压力与强敌夹击，首日赛况已有冷门苗头，今日需稳固心态争取更多晋级名额。
羽毛球.en:
Badminton action is centered on the Indonesia Open in Jakarta, a Super 1000 event. Chinese players are in the thick of Day 2 competition. Wang Zhiyi faced Singapore's Yang Jiamin on Court 1 in a match China hopes will continue their strong run. Another Chinese pairing, Jia Yifan and Zhang Shuxian, began their campaign. Meanwhile, veteran Wang Chang is reviewing his performance and preparing for the next round. The tournament is a key indicator for the upcoming Asian Games and World Championships.

- [Wang Zhiyi Vs Letshana: 这场尤伯杯激战太疯狂！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE4yV2VDYkgzLW5IM0c4SExZUWQ3RWpZOFBYTTJzSTFlVFRtcDdhVzMwOFZyNnBVQ0RjUjJvVHR4WUd4LVpsQTd3M0wwUk16c2RKcjF1SmxXckNUNUk)
- [贾一凡张殊贤开赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE03aDY3RTIwaFZGeVU3R1djV3dKUWgza3BRWHAtbXpidVlzUG1qNXYzZjFPZDBVNGJoWHkzaldsbk1NVi1fT09oZkQyd2NXczgzbnBEeTdZejluYmM3cjQtZklXWQ)
- [国羽今日赛程](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1scmhxMmlhb2xOYXdFUWIxM3BCV2RMZEF6cmJSZG9yTjV1RUpILWY4ZVlqcV9JYlZiTEZzWHJhYjJ1Vk1ITGc4bDJxWDVmVzRzR0FIRTZaTWM2Rm01em9NRDFWcw)
- [王昶总结经验再战](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1LRm1TMmU1QWJJSUJIYzhwTmFLQ0lzcTkwcnA1ZFItb1VNTlBBZG9UNHd4NkhJVlhsWnhsRGY0Zk53Yk5VMEh1ZHRoQlBkZHJSdDlFVzN6U29qWVZWUHc0bGpkUQ)

Keep an eye on Wang Zhiyi—her form in Indonesia could determine China's seeding for the next major team event.

虎扑社区动态.zh: 虎扑社区今日热度爆棚，多条动态引发球迷争相讨论。CBA总决赛古德温压哨绝杀广厦的瞬间被反复回放，这是CBA总决赛历史上首次压哨绝杀，直接改变系列赛走势。篮球板块中，美媒晒出文班亚马与亚历山大赛场合照，引发未来巨星对比；香农-夏普直言雷霆赢球唯一原因是哈滕对文班的限制，从侧面证明文班的统治力。足球方面，博洛尼亚加时绝杀罗马晋级欧联八强，坎比亚吉成英雄；卡马文加赛后社媒道歉，承担皇马失利责任；利物浦球员18岁前英超出场排名中恩古莫哈距欧文纪录仅差1次，青训传承引关注。此外，阿纳尔迪4场比赛用时近18小时创大满贯八强时长纪录，网球冷知识也获高热讨论。社区呈现多元体育话题交织，用户互动活跃。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The Chinese fan community Hupu buzzed with a wide range of sports topics. In the NBA, a photo of Wembanyama and SGA surfaced, while Shannon Sharpe credited Hartenstein for limiting Wembanyama in a Thunder win. A tennis marathon saw Arnaldi spend nearly 18 hours on court to reach a Grand Slam quarterfinal—a record. Football news included Bologna's dramatic Europa League win over Roma, and Liverpool youngster Ngumoha closing in on Owen's record for Premier League appearances before age 18. Real Madrid's Camavinga apologized on social media after a poor performance. Additionally, a CBA player Laravia posted a season-high efficiency game.

- [美媒分享动态：一张文班亚马和亚历山大的赛场合照](https://news.google.)
- [[流言板]阿纳尔迪4场比赛用时近18小时，创晋级大满贯八强时长纪录](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE0xR2Y5UXZtLXljQ21sLXpvM2gzOXA2NmVQempYZlRpd25HOFl1SDU5aW5Cc3VFc09EZW5sVnVyU2xEMjVoanRyWFdUSHNfdkxCVlRuWGRHcE5QYS00Qy01WUxHZHZ4NEJldGJlUnNYS0dMRFd1ekow)
- [卡马文加社媒：我会承担该承担的责任，向球队和球迷们道歉](https://news.google.)
- [利物浦球员18岁前英超出场排名：恩古莫哈距榜首欧文仅差1次](https://news.google.)

Hupu's eclectic mix reflects Chinese fans' broad interests; the CBA and NBA narratives are particularly active as playoffs continue.

篮球.zh: 今日篮球板块焦点集中于CBA与NBA选秀。CBA总决赛上演历史性一幕：山西外援古德温压哨绝杀广厦，成为CBA总决赛历史上首次压哨绝杀，瞬间点燃全网篮球迷激情，这记绝杀很可能成为系列赛转折点。NBA方面，中国球员杨瀚森在最新模拟选秀中被预测首轮第16顺位，标志着继周琦后中国球员再次接近NBA舞台，消息引发国内球迷对新一代移动长城的热切期待。另外，南京同曦主场购票信息出现在虎扑社区，预示新赛季CBA主场氛围有望升温。综合来看，CBA总决赛的激烈程度与杨瀚森的选秀前景是当下篮球圈最核心话题。
篮球.en:
Basketball news is headlined by a historic moment in the CBA Finals: a buzzer-beater by Goodwin that gave his team a win over Guangsha—the first such game-winner in CBA Finals history. Meanwhile, Chinese prospect Yang Hansen was reportedly selected 16th overall in the first round of an NBA draft (likely the 2025 draft, but referenced now), a significant step for Chinese basketball. On a local level, Nanjing's home game ticket sales are active.

- [[流言板]古德温压哨绝杀广厦，成为CBA总决赛历史上首次压哨绝杀](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBreHVjdjRxUld3QzV4anhjLXZueWtIbWhKcGszYUY5SkZVak54clNVUjExTFZTdXlXUUVvRXZJX1d4andXUGdHMXQyazdSaFhGZUhFYXRZUmo3alVSOVJNeHZ5QUgxLVpMX3BiN2FwUmRJdEdfQjhr)
- [南京主场买票](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPb3k0UE5KcGoyMnFjcFoxSVN0czBnOGItelJoNTUzc2pZczFQa3hJSjc2MjV1YldiOEt2am9HaWlJX0Y0VGxuVjdmRVg1bm5YaXgwbUhrNU5iZlJYREJaZjJTN2gtV1dpR1paTlhmbUR2X2gwSlNYeXBWaHpRXzVKSWx3T1ZZdWtjYkJscGtsRU5uMGNLd1VV)
- [杨瀚森首轮16顺位](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFA2b3pKeWp4M1lkbEQzMlc3Rlg4bkR2WC03S096ampqa2tCdVQ0c2JGbXJBVll2UkxpRVZvVTgzeXBaU21ZbWFBWHMtcndGdDVTZngtWG1lYUh6OW5mSlBtb3M3aw)

The CBA Finals are now more unpredictable after that dramatic finish; Yang Hansen's draft news could signal a new wave of Chinese talent in the NBA.

欧美.zh: 今日欧美娱乐线被政治与媒体管理层地震主导。Scott Pelley被CBS News解雇后激烈反击，[直言“60分钟”领导层价值观崩塌](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/scott-pelley-60-minutes-firing-cbs-response-1235571526/)，这是Paramount Skydance收购后新闻编辑室文化冲突的集中爆发。与此同时，洛杉矶市长初选出现奇观——真人秀明星Spencer Pratt与现任市长Bass进入对决，[Deadline和Variety均报道其领先幅度](https://deadline.com/2026/06/spencer-pratt-karen-bass-l-a-mayor-election-results-runoff-1236939564/)，娱乐资本的选票转化能力值得警惕。产业层面，Netflix《四季》和《好女孩谋杀指南》第二季首周观看量分别仅440万和更低，[延续平台二季度续集疲软趋势](https://deadline.com/2026/06/four-seasons-good-girls-guide-to-murder-s2-premiere-viewership-1236939594/)。音乐方面，Taylor Swift盛赞Paul McCartney新专辑，[R.E.M.主唱Michael Stipe与Andrew Watt在Kimmel首演合作曲](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/michael-stipe-andrew-watt-i-played-the-fool-kimmel-1235571519/)。此外，Sydney Sweeney参与的项目《Hollow》已打包准备冲击市场，[Lindsey Anderson Beer将改编自己小说并执导](https://deadline.com/2026/06/lindsey-anderson-beer-hollow-sydney-sweeney-luckychap-1236939092/)。本质上看，欧美娱乐新闻的“政治化”和“管理权之争”正在取代单纯的票房或收视话题。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk saw explosive news from CBS News' internal crisis and the bizarre L.A. mayoral race. Scott Pelley's firing dominated headlines with multiple outlets covering his blistering statement. Meanwhile, the California governor primary between Steve Hilton and Xavier Becerra is too close to call. In film, Sydney Sweeney is producing and starring in 'Hollow', and Robert Pattinson addressed body-shaming. Music news included Taylor Swift's McCartney praise and Michael Stipe's 'Kimmel' performance. The Oscar-nominated documentary 'The Voice of Hind Rajab' was cleared for release in India after censorship.

- **Scott Pelley fired from '60 Minutes'** after a stormy meeting; he calls CBS News leadership 'incompetent' and accuses them of a 'collapse of values'.
