日韩.zh: 韩剧与K-pop继续双线发力。SBS下半年新剧阵容曝光，[Lee Je Hoon将出演《The Long Shot Trial》饰演只接必败案件的古怪律师](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845426wpp/lee-je-hoon-is-an-eccentric-law-office-manager-who-only-takes-on-unwinnable-cases-in-new-drama-the-long-shot-trial)，[Park Min Young和Yook Sungjae搭档办公室恋情《Nine to Six》](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845422wpp/park-min-young-and-yook-sungjae-meet-as-deputy-manager-and-intern-in-new-office-romance-drama)，[So Ji Sub的复仇动作剧《Agent Kim Reactivated》放出新预告](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845419wpp/watch-so-ji-sub-returns-to-action-after-his-daughter-faces-danger-in-agent-kim-reactivated)。收视方面，ENA《Doctor on the Edge》第二集回升至5.0%，而tvN《The Legend of Kitchen Soldier》继续领跑。K-pop方面，[TREASURE迷你专《NEW WAV》首日销量达592,158张破自身纪录](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845353wpp/treasure-breaks-their-1st-day-sales-record-tops-itunes-charts-worldwide-with-new-wav)，[XLOV新专首周销量接近是前作三倍](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845350wpp/xlov-nearly-triples-their-1st-week-sales-record-with-igod)，[CORTIS的《GREENGREEN》在Billboard 200上停留三周至第42位](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845356wpp/cortis-breaks-personal-record-as-greengreen-spends-3rd-week-on-billboard-200)。品牌声誉方面，[ILLIT的Wonhee蝉联6月新人偶像榜首](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845365wpp/june-individual-rookie-idol-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-2)。日韩市场呈现出“老牌稳、新团冲”的格局，竞争白热化。
日韩.en:
K-pop continues to dominate with strong sales and chart performances. TREASURE's 'NEW WAV' sold over 592,000 copies on its first day, breaking their personal record. XLOV nearly tripled first-week sales with 'I,God', and CORTIS holds steady on the Billboard 200. In drama, SBS unveiled its upcoming lineup featuring Lee Je Hoon, Park Min Young, Yook Sungjae, and So Ji Sub. Ratings for 'Doctor on the Edge' rose to 5.0% in its second episode.

- **TREASURE** broke first-day sales record with 'NEW WAV', topping iTunes charts globally. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845353wpp/treasure-breaks-their-1st-day-sales-record-tops-itunes-charts-worldwide-with-new-wav))
- **XLOV** nearly tripled first-week sales with 'I,God', surpassing 110,000 copies in two days. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845350wpp/xlov-nearly-triples-their-1st-week-sales-record-with-igod))
- **CORTIS** remains on Billboard 200 for third week at No. 42. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845356wpp/cortis-breaks-personal-record-as-greengreen-spends-3rd-week-on-billboard-200))
- **New dramas**: 'The Long Shot Trial' (Lee Je Hoon), 'Nine to Six' (Park Min Young, Yook Sungjae), 'Agent Kim Reactivated' (So Ji Sub). ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845426wpp/lee-je-hoon-is-an-eccentric-law-office-manager-who-only-takes-on-unwinnable-cases-in-new-drama-the-long-shot-trial), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845422wpp/park-min-young-and-yook-sungjae-meet-as-deputy-manager-and-intern-in-new-office-romance-drama), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845419wpp/watch-so-ji-sub-returns-to-action-after-his-daughter-faces-danger-in-agent-kim-reactivated))
- **June rookie idol brand reputation**: Wonhee (ILLIT) tops the list. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845365wpp/june-individual-rookie-idol-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-2))

Expect continued monitoring of K-pop album sales momentum and viewer reception of SBS's new slate.

微博社区动态.en:

A fan spot of Miriam Yeung (杨千嬅) in Xiamen went viral, while dating show contestant Zhang Zixin (章梓馨) faced a 'lookalike' controversy with Jang Wonyoung. 中国.zh: 中国娱乐线在戛纳电影节余温与票房爆款中展开。[第79届戛纳“中国之夜”圆满收官](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTFBFOHFmVms2ckh3WmFTQkpvTHBLaE4zX1QxU0w0b3FwbzY3ZV96RlF6QW45S2xvcUdDTGMteTNZdnFHamxMalZJUC1lazQ4WUk0dTdIRUNzUkhXR2VvbTI0MlM3RnA)，活动首次在国际发布中国AIGC影视成果，[科技+非遗+品牌三维驱动被视为文化出海新标杆](https://news.google.)。国内票房方面，[《给阿嬷的情书》突破14亿，被分析为“中国影视文化战略转型的开始”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNMjl5cjdFS0RHM1MyUTZhcFcwSzVQRl9mOW5HVGZqaHJvaFlLaDllQUxUREdoZF94THBGVE85VTM4d0VsUG5oS05iSVFTTjdGcF9fTDAxaUY2dzQyVDJIRXE2dWNpUjQ5NWVncVg3a04zdWZ2Q3pZeG9SQ1c1dHZjekN1TWNQRUE2NElN)，该片与《人世间》《山海情》等一同被归为当代现实主义书写范例。此外，[周星驰宣布进军AI产业被戏称“娱乐圈黄仁勋”](https://news.google.)。[吴哲在亚洲国际青年影人之夜获年度最具潜力少年演员奖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE14cWhCUl9hUkJDUm5PVldIaU9OOW9UVy1Wc3pEVmZvQzR5WE5KdmVRRmZzMGFDbHo1R2JlbHhkUWZiWjVwTTVPM3FrdWdDTkxHOGlmdHNad0NmNjQ)。中国娱乐正从流量驱动转向内容质量+科技赋能双轮驱动，戛纳成果与票房数据印证了这一趋势。
中国.en:
Chinese entertainment saw a landmark box office achievement and a major cultural export push. Stephen Chow (周星驰) announced his entry into AI, earning the nickname 'Huang Renxun of entertainment'. '给阿嬷的情书' crossed ¥1.4 billion, with commentators calling it a strategic shift for Chinese cinema. The Cannes 'China Night' event highlighted AI-powered filmmaking and cultural diplomacy, with Chinese AIGC works showcased for the first time internationally. Meanwhile, young actor Wu Zhe won a promising newcomer award in Asia.

- **Stephen Chow enters AI industry**, netizens dub him 'entertainment Huang Renxun'. ([中國報](https://news.google.))
- **'给阿嬷的情书' box office** surpasses ¥1.4 billion; article suggests it marks a strategic turn in Chinese film culture. ([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNMjl5cjdFS0RHM1MyUTZhcFcwSzVQRl9mOW5HVGZqaHJvaFlLaDllQUxUREdoZF94THBGVE85VTM4d0VsUG5oS05iSVFTTjdGcF9fTDAxaUY2dzQyVDJIRXE2dWNpUjQ5NWVncVg3a04zdWZ2Q3pZeG9SQ1c1dHZjekN1TWNQRUE2NElN))
- **Cannes 'China Night'** showcased Chinese films and AI technology, with 'China Film+' forum discussing AI empowerment. ([财中社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTFBFOHFmVms2ckh3WmFTQkpvTHBLaE4zX1QxU0w0b3FwbzY3ZV96RlF6QW45S2xvcUdDTGMteTNZdnFHamxMalZJUC1lazQ4WUk0dTdIRUNzUkhXR2VvbTI0MlM3RnA), [手机新浪网](https://news.google.))
- **Wu Zhe wins 'Most Promising Young Actor'** at Asian International Youth Film Night. ([中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE14cWhCUl9hUkJDUm5PVldIaU9OOW9UVy1Wc3pEVmZvQzR5WE5KdmVRRmZzMGFDbHo1R2JlbHhkUWZiWjVwTTVPM3FrdWdDTkxHOGlmdHNad0NmNjQ))

Track Stephen Chow's AI venture and the continued box office run of '给阿嬷的情书' as bellwethers for Chinese entertainment's new direction.
